articleTitle: An Investigation into Deep Learning Based Network Intrusion Detection System for IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) is a crucial part of the security implementation for service providers, organizations, and entities to protect connected devices on their networks. NIDS proactively detect and identify various threats and intrusions thus protecting sensitive data transmitted over the network. With the wide-scale adaptation and exponential growth of IoT devices connected to the network, having capable and highly efficient IDS becomes more necessary than ever. The NIDS rely on historical data to analyse the network information and to detect threats and intrusions. This paper conducts a comparative study of the use of modern deep learning models such as Fully Convolutional Network (FCN) and Autoencoder combined with Fully Connected Network (Autoencoder-FCN) to distinguish normal network data from attack data. This study uses CICIDS2017 dataset (over 2.8M network data records) representing real-world data and contains both normal data and attack data corresponding to the most up to date common attacks seen in modern network environments. The performance of both FCN and Autoencoder-FCN was observed to be highly accurate with the accuracy parameter being above 97% and low error rates. FCN model performs slightly better than the Autoencoder-FCN model. However, FCN model exhibited lower training time in a local deployment environment compared to the Autoencoder-FCN model.

articleTitle: Computer numerical simulation study of sliding friction temperature of pantograph carbon skateboard
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The pantograph carbon skateboard is the key electrical equipment for high-speed rail power locomotives to obtain electrical energy. Its working status directly affects the power supply and safe operation of the entire train. When the carbon slide plate is in contact with the catenary and receives electricity, a large current will be generated, which will cause heating, and the carbon slide plate’s wear pits, uneven surface, uneven wear and other factors will cause sparking and arcing, which will cause it to break and open., Warpage and deformation and other operational safety failures. This paper uses COMSOL Multiphysics software combined with SolidWorks to establish a dynamic heat-receiving model of pantograph sliding plate, converts equivalent thermal power into heat flux as the heat source, and conducts multi-physics finite element simulation analysis. The production of pantograph-net contact resistance is considered. The Joule heat and the frictional heat generated by the friction of the pantograph net are analyzed. The influencing factors and changing laws of the temperature of the pantograph slide are analyzed. The influencing factors include current, air convection coefficient, contact pressure, speed, carbon slide material, ambient temperature and pull-out Value etc. Considering the dynamic change and distribution law of the temperature of the pantograph carbon sliding plate with the external environment temperature under different currents and fluctuating contact pressures, this article has practical application value.

articleTitle: Chinese Painting Style Transfer System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The paper first briefly summarizes the development of image style transfer technology and the current mainstream technology route, and then focuses on the analysis of the types and characteristics of Chinese painting. On this basis, it describes the migration implementation algorithm of six typical Chinese painting styles based on the deep learning network, and designs the application software framework to realize the program functions. Finally, the results of the implementation of the program were analyzed and discussed. The proposed algorithm and software have certain application value. With the software, ordinary digital pictures or paintings can be transfer the ones with different Chinese painting styles, which has played a positive role in the promotion of Chinese painting and Chinese culture.

articleTitle: Research on Path Following Control Method of Agricultural Machinery Autonomous Navigation through LQR-Feed Forward Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of agricultural machinery autonomous navigation path tracking motion control, based on the analysis of the characteristics of agricultural machinery tracking control, this paper proposes a motion control method with feedforward control LQR. By constructing a two-degree-of-freedom dynamic model of agricultural machinery, analyzing the lateral deviation and heading deviation of path tracking, the LQR controller and feedforward controller in the path tracking of agricultural machinery are designed to eliminate the lateral steady-state error of path tracking control. Through the joint simulation of Carsim and Matlab/Simulink, the tracking deviation of the agricultural machinery in the process of tracking the planned path is obtained. The results show that the algorithm can effectively enable agricultural machinery to perform accurate path tracking operations, and provides a basis for the research of autonomous navigation control algorithms for agricultural machinery.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Cloud Storage Security
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the continuous progress of current science and technology, cloud computing has been widely used in various fields. This paper proposes a secure data storage architecture based on cloud computing. The architecture studies the security issues of cloud computing from two aspects: data storage and data security, and proposes a data storage mode based on Cache and a data security mode based on third-party authentication, thereby improving the availability of data, from data storage to transmission. Corresponding protection measures have been established to realize effective protection of cloud data.

articleTitle: BOD5 prediction based on PSO optimized BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A PSO-BP model for soft measurement of BOD5 is proposed for the nonlinearity, high time-variability and difficulty of online measurement during the change of key water quality parameters (such as BOD5) in wastewater treatment process. The model introduces PSO into BP, which is used to optimize the weights and thresholds of BP, enabling the algorithm to obtain the optimal parameters adaptively, forming the BOD5 prediction model of PSO-BPNN. The experimental results show that the PSO-BP model has a smaller root mean square error and the highest correlation coefficient in prediction results compared with BP, RBF, ELM, and jellyfish algorithm optimized BPNN (JS-BP). It shows that the PSO-BP model is significantly better than other models in prediction accuracy and interference resistance.

articleTitle: Research on Improved SVR Strength Smart Prediction Using Support Vector Machine Regression Algorithm and sEMG
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As the muscle strength of human body cannot be accurately calculated, a method of muscle strength prediction based on surface EMG signals is proposed. First, use the support vector machine regression algorithm to train the EMG and muscle strength regression prediction model. Further study the comparison between the proposed muscle strength regression prediction model and other common regression algorithms. Experimental results show that the method can accurately predict muscle strength, and the model has the smallest mean square error and root mean square error).

articleTitle: Discriminant Sensitive Harmonic Correlation Fault Diagnosis for Rolling Bearing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Multi-view canonical correlation analysis (MCCA) is an important multivariate statistical analysis method for bearing fault diagnosis. The correlations and scatters of MCCA are based on unsupervised arithmetic means, and the arithmetic means have has some limitations such as equal weight deviation and discriminant insensitivity. To solve the limitations, we propose a novel discriminant sensitive harmonic correlation fault diagnosis method for rolling bearing, i.e. harmonic multi-view canonical correlation analysis. In the method, we construct between-view harmonic discriminant correlations and within-view harmonic discriminant scatters by using harmonic means, and thus a harmonic correlation feature learning model of bearing faults is developed. The correlation fault features with well class separability can be learned by our method. Encouraging experimental results show the effectiveness of our method in bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining and Fusion Technology in the Security Management of Sensitive Data in Data Center
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nowadays, network security problems are emerging one after another. In the face of these security problems, various security products have appeared. At the same time, various security products deployed in the network generate a large number of security events (log files) every day, and how to extract valuable information has become an urgent problem to be solved. The purpose of this article is to study the application of data mining and fusion technology in the security management of sensitive data in the data center. This article first summarizes the basic theories of data mining and fusion, and then extends the core technology of data mining and data fusion, and side-by-side combined with the current status of the security management of sensitive data in the data center, we use data mining and fusion technology to research and analyze the application of the sensitive data security management in the data center. This paper systematically explains the architecture and algorithm implementation of security management based on data mining and fusion technology, and the application of data mining and fusion technology in the security management of sensitive data in the data center is investigated and researched through the comparative method, field research and other research methods. The experimental research shows that the sensitive data security is compared with the traditional data center. Management, the data security management system using data mining and fusion technology has more excellent performance.

articleTitle: Computer mathematical statistics applied in the housing price investigation through machine learning and linear regression model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To Figure out the inner law of the housing price in Beijing and the key factors that influence the housing price, quantitative analysis is used through three statistical tools: autoregressive moving average model, linear regression model and random forest model. The first model shows that the coefficient of autoregressive part is greater than one, revealing an increasing trend of housing price. The second model shows that there are four factors, number of residents in Beijing, production of tertiary industry, per capita urban disposal income, number of elementary school students, have strong linear relationship with the housing price. From the third model, there are three factors, number of subways, number of buses and number of medical institutions, may have strong non-linear relationship with housing price. Then the conclusions that the increasing trend of housing price in Beijing may be kept in the future, there are 7 main factors having robust relationship with the housing price in Beijing, though some of them may not be linear and the statistical tools can be really helpful in analyzing the field of housing price or some other fields have been reached.

articleTitle: Research on Decision-Making optimization for Operation System of Power Grid Framework under Smart Grid and Dijkstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The article proposes a load transfer model based on the Dijkstra algorithm after an accident in the distribution network, and builds the load transfer auxiliary decision-making system LTADS. The article first introduces the overall architecture of the platform; secondly, it introduces the main functions and technologies of the supporting platform from four aspects: data processing, power grid fault diagnosis, graphics management, and intelligent decision-making; finally, through the promotion and application of the platform, it demonstrates the diagnosis and analysis of the status of the platform., Application and benefits in planning business such as planning feasibility study preparation and review. The popularization and application of this platform can realize the precise positioning of weak links and potential risks of the power grid, and provide a new informatization auxiliary method for the optimization of the power grid.

articleTitle: A Study on Computer Assisted Multi-Dimensional Intelligent Teaching through Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The multi-dimensional construction of college English system is an inevitable choice for higher education to move toward diversification, internationalization and modernization. Exploring the construction of college English education system through a multicultural perspective will help achieve the sustainable development of English education. English education must persist in implementing diversified teaching strategies and create a cultural education system with humanistic characteristics. Based on this research background, the article establishes the application evaluation of the diversified teaching system of college English. The article first established a classroom teaching evaluation index system, and then used the analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of each index in the classroom teaching evaluation system. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model finally obtains the evaluation results and analyzes and summarizes them.

Author Keywords: evaluation system of teaching culture system

articleTitle: Intelligent Internet of Things Analysis Technology for Intelligent Operation and Maintenance Images of Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Traditional power grid equipment operation and maintenance management has problems such as inability to share data and rely on human supervision to maintain safety, which cannot meet the development requirements of smart grids. Through the technological transformation of the equipment in the substation, all equipment including the secondary equipment will be connected to the network to complete the functions of intelligent identification, status tracking, and intelligent alarms of the equipment. At the same time, through the integration and integration of equipment data, the intelligent aggregation and distribution of equipment information is realized, and the management level of power grid equipment is improved.

articleTitle: Acoustic Imaging Technology and Its Application in Fault Diagnosis of Switch Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the technical level and effect of substation intelligent maintenance, a new fault diagnosis technology based on acoustic imaging is studied and put into application in this paper. The noise characteristics of typical switch cabinet are analyzed. The delay-and-sum beamforming principle is introduced. A 64-channel planar spiral acoustic array is designed and optimized. The sound source localization device is developed and its reliability and stability is verified by laboratory test. Further, the technology is used for on-site fault diagnosis of a switch cabinet. A design defect is successfully observed. It will be provided as a new condition monitoring technology for intelligent maintenance of power apparatus.

articleTitle: Overview of image mosaic technology by computer vision and digital image processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Image mosaic technology has become an important research object in the fields of computer vision, computer graphics and digital image processing technology, and has achieved some results. This paper introduces the image mosaic technology and its application fields; Image mosaic technology includes three basic parts: image preprocessing technology, image registration technology and image fusion technology. This paper mainly introduces the basic algorithm of image preprocessing technology, image registration technology and image fusion technology commonly used algorithm, and it is analyzed and summarized; At the end of the paper, the existing problems of image Mosaic technology are put forward, and the development trend of image Mosaic technology is prospected.

articleTitle: State of art on object detection solution applied to COVID 19’s spreading prevention
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to effectively prevent the spread of COVID19, people from different parts of the world were supposed to be wearing face masks after the WHO put it as a primordial instruction to stop its propagation. Researchers from different backgrounds gathered their efforts to ensure the respect of wearing face mask, namely AI field researchers. In this research, we are interested on the AI applications that were done from the beginning of the pandemic to prevent the COVID 19 contamination, especially those related to the mask wearing detection. The detection of wearing mask is classified as a computer vision problem, more specifically, an object detection one. Besides, with the evolution of the computational power and the availability of huge number of datasets, deep learning models using image and video processing techniques were proposed in order to detect people transgressing the wearing mask rule. In this paper we introduce a literature review of object detection, a case study of this problem which consists in the wearing mask detection, the related works as well as the different proposed solutions, and the suggested general pipeline for the treatment of this problem.

articleTitle: Research on Applied Undergraduate Education Resource Allocation System Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At this stage, the total amount of teaching resources in our country is small, the quality is not high, the resources are duplicated and the sharing and application are low. In order to balance educational resources, create open teaching resources, realize cross-sharing of resources among various disciplines, and provide users with a new model of on-demand services. Based on the related technologies of cloud computing, this paper presents a cloud computing-based applied undergraduate education resource allocation model according to the user’s task demand for resources in the open undergraduate education resource allocation. And designed the architecture model of the application-based undergraduate education resource allocation system based on cloud computing.

articleTitle: GMPPS Based Face Mask Detection of Infrared Thermal Image for Ultra-Small Training Data Set
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Wearing face masks is an effective measure to prevent COVID-19. Infrared thermal image based temperature measurement and identity recognition system has been widely used in many large enterprises and universities in China, so it is totally necessary to research the face mask detection of thermal infrared imaging efficiently. A novel method named as GMPPS was proposed in this paper, which Gray Histogram Equalization and Gaussian Filter was adopted to pre-processing the image, then Max-pooling and fast PCA was used to extract the feature, and SVM was employed to classify the data finally. The experiment was performed on 3 different scales of training data set, the results showed that the average face mask recognition of the method can be up to 99.638% for 800 test samples only with 32 training samples, and the average test time overhead for one sample is 1. 0749s, and the method’s performance is very robust.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of the Morning Commute Problem with Network Platform Shared Parking
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of morning commute with parking when shared parking spaces are used as a supplement out of not enough parking spots are provided by workplace. This paper studies the impact of shared parking pricing on users’ travel behavior based on the bottleneck model. And there are two categories in shared parking pricing: low-pricing strategy and high-pricing strategy, nine possible UE travel modes are analyzed and the key parameters are solved. On this basis, taking four different central parking lots as examples, the influence of shared parking pricing on the total social cost and queuing time of the system is analyzed. Some findings are: reducing the shared parking pricing is not desirable,which may lead to the waste of central parking space resources; in most sutiation of shortage of central parking spaces, the shared parking pricing adjusted to the high-pricing strategy of the travel mode O8,can not only minimize the cost of social travel but can alleviate road congestion; It is worth noting that in the sutiation of extreme shortage of central parking spaces, only the price of shared parking in travel model 4 can make the total social cost reach the minimum.

articleTitle: Development Status of Intelligent Evaluation Model of Food Sensory by Instrument Detection and Computer Mathematical Statistics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Food sensory evaluation is a subject developed on the basis of psychology, physiology and statistics, which is based on the rapid, simple and effective test of the special properties of food by means of human senses. It has great significance in the quality control of food enterprises, the research and development of new food products, and the identification of food adulteration. It is an important test method the same as physical and chemical inspection, microbial testing. This paper is elaborate from food sensory evaluation development, food sensory evaluation purpose and food sensory evaluation common inspection method in the food processing and production.

articleTitle: Construction and Simulation of Electricity Theft Detection Model Based on Clustering and Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of stealing electricity in the process of using electricity, this paper proposes a method to detect stealing electricity in the process of using electricity based on clustering and improved neural network. First, this paper analyzes the data characteristics of the people’s electricity consumption in our country. Based on the idea of clustering and improved neural network, it solves the selection difficulty of training samples in the process of electricity stealing prediction modeling, and constructs the optimal sample set. Then, it studies the optimal sample set on the basis of neural network. Finally, it analyzes the electricity stealing process Prediction simulation experiment. The experimental results show that, compared with RNN neural network algorithm, the accuracy of the algorithm based on clustering and improved neural network is improved to 94.55%, the loss of cross entropy of the model is reduced to 0.244, and the AUC is improved to 0.879, so the comprehensive performance of the algorithm has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Computer Aided Costume Design and Machine Vision Technology in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The research on the development of ethnic minority costume design in the era of big data reminds us that the advantages of big data technology should be fully cited in the design of ethnic minorities’ costumes, so as to apply innovative ideas and modes in each link of the design process of ethnic minorities’ costumes and play a revolutionary role in promoting the design of ethnic minorities’ costumes.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Textile Industry Big Data Using Computer Mathematical Statistics and Double Difference Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the full implementation of China's "going global" strategy, corporate social responsibility behavior of China's overseas investment has attracted the attention of the international community and the Chinese government. This paper uses the panel data of China's listed textile and garment enterprises for eight years, by using the cutting-edge propensity score matching method and the double difference method. The results show that: Overseas investment has significantly improved the level of social responsibility of textile and garment enterprises. In view of this, from the government and enterprises two aspects of China's textile and garment enterprises to put forward relevant suggestions and opinions.

articleTitle: Communication Signal Modulation Recognition Based on Time-Frequency Domain Analysis and Bayesian optimized Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Communication signal modulation mode recognition technology plays a crucial role in communication confrontation in the modern war environment. Due to the low accuracy of the traditional communication signal recognition methods, this paper introduces a method to identify modulation modes of communication signals based on a Bayesian optimized decision tree. In this paper, a modulation mode recognition method of communication signals based on Bayesian optimization and decision tree is proposed. First, simulate the signals of different modulation modes, including frequency-shift keying modulation (FSK), frequency modulation (FM), amplitude modulation (AM). Then the signal data is processed by using the time and frequency domain feature extraction algorithm. Next, the obtained data is used to train and verify the decision tree. And the model parameters are optimized by the Bayesian method. The recognition of these three communication modulation signals is realized, and the accuracy is up to 94%.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Research on Digital Economy Information System through Cloud Computing and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The real existence of digital economy phenomena such as Internet economy, intelligent economy, sharing economy and experience economy is pushing economists to analyze and study the digital economy model. The digital economy model is extremely broad. In terms of the current development, big data technology has become one of the hottest topics in various fields of the current society. The advantages of big data technology need to be brought into play by relying on the Internet platform. Therefore, in order to give full play to the role of big data in economic construction, relevant research work is very important. This paper first makes a brief introduction to the concept and characteristics of big data, and combined with the importance of big data in social economy, reveals the meaning of digital economics under the environment of big data, and analyzes the reform brought by big data and its application countermeasures. Finally, the development trend of digital economics is forecasted, and the strategy of macroeconomic analysis with the help of big data is put forward.

articleTitle: Sinusoidal representation of transient signal based on Hilbert transform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to analyze the characteristics of power system transient signal and calculate the derivative of transient signal, it is a feasible method to fit the function expression of transient signal based on sampled signal, but the existing transient signal fitting methods still have the shortcomings of certainty and derivability of fitting function. To solve this problem, a sinusoidal representation method for transient signal analysis of power system based on Hilbert transform is proposed in this paper. Sine function of transient signal is used to form a fitting basis function, and the Hilbert transform is used to meet the certainty of fitting function. Compared with the existing methods, this method can directly decompose the steady-state component and transient component of fault transient signal, and its transient component can reflect the attenuation characteristics of fault signal; this method can also fit the function expression of transient signal, and then calculate the arbitrary order derivative value of transient voltage and current signal, which is the basis of many signal processing calculations. Through the analysis of a set of given signals and a set of field recorded signals, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Data Model System for Optimizing the Performance of Computer Web Front End
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of Web front-ends, Web pages have become more and more complex, and strong interactivity has brought about the skyrocketing of page status, and more and more DOM operations are used to update pages. However, frequent DOM operations make page rendering slow and cause front-end performance bottlenecks. In view of the low performance of the Web front-end, we analyze and summarize the B/S architecture principles from the back-end to the front-end of the Web, browser caching, browser loading methods, server configuration related to HTTP, and other processes that affect the front-end performance optimization. Factors, systematically propose a complete Web front-end performance optimization solution designed to improve web page loading speed, rendering speed and user experience, with strong integrity and versatility. In order to effectively reduce the waiting time of users, a calculation model of connection request scheduling weight is proposed, and a request scheduling algorithm SACC is proposed on the basis of this model. Experiments have proved that the algorithm can effectively reduce the TDD and TSR indicators of web pages. In the experimental platform IE7, the average reduction rate is 13% and 25% respectively.

articleTitle: Computer Mathematical Statistics Analysis and Research on the Quantitative Relationship between Shyness and Internet Addiction under Massive Network Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article reviews existing research on the relationship between shyness and Internet addiction, comparing methodology and sample traits. The article begins with a discussion of measures of shyness, focusing in particular on the popular Cheek and Buss Scale as well as recent alternatives suggested to this scale that provide greater specificity for certain groups. All the studies examined indicate a positive correlation between shyness and Internet addiction, but some researchers have posited a role for mediating variables such as loneliness avoidance, gender, or locus of control in between these two traits to further clarify the relationship, if any, between these phenomena. Evidence for these mediating variables is strong.

articleTitle: Research on Behavior Mathematical Modeling of CGF Based on Reinforcement Learning under Complex Electromagnetic Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the modeling of agent behavior in complex electromagnetic environment. By using reinforcement learning technology, The traditional Markov decision process and dynamic programming algorithm are improved. The electromagnetic field intensity function is integrated with Markov decision process and dynamic programming algorithm, and high precision virtual battlefield environment is evaluated based on system simulation, in order to facilitate the modeling of the agent’s behavior, this paper meshes the complex electromagnetic battlefield environment and sets up the simulation task scene of agent’s maneuvering task using simulation and evaluation system. Several simulation tests were implemented to collect relative test data. The comparison was made with the traditional Markov decision algorithm from three dimensions, including time, space and working condition of electronic devices inside equipment. The results show that the improved Markov decision algorithm and dynamic programming algorithm proposed in this paper show better adaptability to adapt complex electromagnetic environment than traditional Markov algorithm, it will provide a strong support for efficient completion of combat tasks and improvement of combat effectiveness in complex electromagnetic simulation environment, and also lays a foundation for the subsequent research on the CGF behavior modeling method.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Informatization Construction Level of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Smart cities have become an important strategy for the construction of cities, and information construction has become a key task in the construction of smart cities. By constructing a smart city informatization construction level evaluation index system, using entropy weight and TOPSIS method, comparing the data of30 domestic smart cities in 2018, analyzing the current status of smart city informatization construction in various regions in my country, and proposing corresponding smart city informatization construction Suggestions.

articleTitle: A study on the speech timbre space based on subjective evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposed a speech timbre space that can be used for objective evaluation, and a small and medium-sized speech timbre corpus based on expert screening is developed. First, we collected 32 vocabularies describing vibratory vocalizations by reviewing a large number of literatures (e.g., musical instruments and human voice, etc.). For the vocabularies with high similarity, the series category method and multidimensional scaling were used to filter and determine the dimensions of the speech timbre space that match the subjective listening perception. Next, we used k-means clustering to obtain the final 5-dimensional speech timbre space. Finally, we collected a large number of pure Chinese speech sounds from the Internet and conducted subjective evaluation experiments to obtain a corpus with timbre labels. The results of the subjective experiments show that the established speech timbre space can describe the speech in daily life. This timbre space can be subsequently put into deep learning to process the input audio with timbre labels.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Chinese Medicine Based on Ancient Record Database and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Pulse diagnosis is a characteristic method of traditional Chinese medicine, but it lacks a unified standard. The use of computer technology can standardize and unify pulse diagnosis; Traditional Chinese medicine is a valuable medical medicine in China. Using computer can further explore the application of traditional Chinese medicine and explore the action mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine.

Author Keywords: computer application research in the field of traditional Chinese Medicine

articleTitle: Safety Protection System Computer Aided Design in Enclosed Vehicle Using Film Pressure Sensor and Microwave Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the phenomenon that children are stranded in enclosed vehicle and lead to their death from time to time, a safety protection system based on STM32 is designed. With the safety seat as the carrier and STM32 as the main control chip, the film pressure sensor and microwave radar are used to detect whether there are children sitting, the temperature, the humidity sensor and the carbon dioxide in enclosed vehicle. When the threshold is exceeded, it will alarm. Build an intelligent monitoring system with the trinity of perception, calculation and alarm. The experimental debugging results show that the safety protection system can better meet the needs of safety protection for children stranded in enclosed vehicle.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Artificial Intelligence Algorithm in Network Search System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article studies the personalization mechanism in the agent-based intelligent meta-search engine, accurately understands the user’s search intent, and effectively improves the quality of information retrieval services. This article focuses on the study of the agent-based intelligent metasearch engine personalization method and related theories and techniques required for function realization are given, query sentence analysis, query interest mining and member search engine scheduling process are given. The agent-based intelligent meta-search engine personalization mechanism proposed in the article can more accurately identify complex query sentences and preprocess them, efficiently learn users’ query interests, and achieve the purpose of significantly improving the relevance of search results, and intelligently Dispatch member search engines to provide full support for improving the efficiency of user information retrieval, thereby improving the user’s retrieval experience.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerance Technique Based on State Real-time Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Key service hosts in information systems have higher and higher requirements on high reliability and survivability. Combined with the development trend of fault-tolerant technology, the mechanisms of data synchronization, memory synchronization, IO synchronization, fault detection, and transparent switching between active and standby are introduced, and a dual-machine redundancy high availability model based on state real-time synchronization is constructed. In order to reduce the overhead of memory state synchronization, an event-driven memory synchronization trigger mechanism is designed, that is, the key IO event-driven event trigger mechanism is adopted for the synchronization timing of memory checkpoints, so as to minimize unnecessary memory data update operations between the main and standby computers and reduce the overhead of computer state synchronization. At the same time, combined with BMC monitoring interface based on physical host, a fine-grained fault detection method is proposed. Related work can greatly reduce the overhead caused by high availability mechanism, and reduce the impact of fault-tolerant mechanism on system computing performance to a certain extent. At the same time, it has the ability to switch between active and standby quickly, which is helpful to better guarantee the uninterrupted and continuous running ability of task applications in key systems.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Logistics Navigation Device Based on SLAM Dual Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a mapping and navigation algorithm for dual lidar under the ROS platform, and designs an autonomous navigation device based on SLAM lidar, inertial odometer wheel odometer and so on. As the most critical distance sensor, dual SLAM radar captures a full range of distance information. It uses advanced laser SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) framework Cartographer, combined with multiple echo algorithms to achieve long-distance high-precision positioning and mapping reconstruction, based on the improved MRPT (MobileRobot Programming Toolkit) particle filter algorithm for navigation. It combines robots driven by industrial-grade safety motor to establish a complete intelligent navigation system, which can realize trackless autonomous navigation in the logistics industry.

articleTitle: Design of an Indoor Surveying and Mapping Robot Based on SLAM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) are a key technology for indoor mapping and navigation of mobile robots. As traditional surveying and mapping work depends on the general simple tools or Artificial completed exist inaccuracies, insecurity and high repeatability errors. To solve the problems mentioned above, an experimental system of mobile robot mapping based on SLAM technology is designed and implemented. The mobile robot is equipped with lidar and odometer sensor. Through the cartographer algorithm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, lidar data and odometer data are integrated to realize indoor map construction and navigation. The open-source robot operating system (ROS) based on Linux was used for realizing information communication, data processing, real-time display between the upper machine and lower machine. The system simulation and real scene test are carried out. The mobile robot can build reliable and efficient map. Compared with the traditional technology of surveying and mapping, simulation and real experiment results show that the system has high practicability and reliability.

articleTitle: List scheduling algorithm of improved priority with considering load balance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at such problems as the load imbalance and low efficiency of DAG task scheduling in the current cloud computing environment, a list scheduling algorithm of improved priority with considering load balance (LS-IPLB) was proposed. In the algorithm, the state parameter change of virtual machine in the cloud computing cluster was abstracted into the parameter vector variation in the space, and the real-time measurement method for the load balance of cloud computing cluster was given, which was taken as an important parameter to select the weight of virtual machine. At the same time, the task priority was calculated through taking the task execution cost, task output value and communication cost between the tasks as the parameters. In addition, the task duplication strategy was used in the task scheduling to further optimize the scheduling process. The results show that the LS-IPLB algorithm can effectively shorten the completion time of DAG task graph, and can achieve good load balance.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Design of Two-wheel Self-balancing Vehicle Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Two-wheeled vehicle is an essentially unstable robot, which has the characteristics of multi-variable, non-linear, strong coupling, time-varying, and parameter so fun certainty. In this paper, the two-wheeled self-balancing vehicle system based on STM32 is designed: (1) In terms of hardware, two reduction motors with parallel distribution at both ends of the uniaxial are used as mobile driving devices. STM32F103C8T6 and MPU6050 are used for real-time attitude acquisition, and the attitude data are decoded by Digital Motion Processor (DMP). (2) In terms of software, the cascade PID is adopted. Based on the obtained attitude data, the controller STM32 calculates the reasonable pulse frequency and pulse number through the PID control algorithm, so as to realize the real-time dynamic control of the two reduction motors and maintain the self-balancing of the car. In addition, based on Android mobile platform and Bluetooth data transmission technology, control mobile APP to complete the real-time control of the car system.

articleTitle: Research on Network Communication Model and Network Security Technology through Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on my country’s current cyberspace security situation and defense requirements, this article analyzes the shortcomings of traditional cybersecurity defense systems and the advantages of applying big data technology for network security analysis, and on this basis, proposes a collection of security data, A security situational awareness platform that integrates processing, analysis, and security risk discovery, monitoring, alarming, and pre-judgment. Experimental results show that the accuracy rate of the evaluation technology is up to 96%, and users can use the network driven by big data to ensure the safety of users’ personal information.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Fusion for Visible Watermark Removal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Considering the diversified features of visible watermarks and the need for a lot of manual operations to remove visible watermarks, we propose watermark removal algorithm based on multi-scale fusion and deep learning, which is suitable for automatic detection and removal of various watermarks. We present a two-step framework: watermark detection and watermark removal. Firstly, we use target detection algorithm to extract the watermark. Then, we adopted the image-to-image translation method based on multi-scale fusion to remove the watermark, and the self-guided loss is added into the loss function. Finally, we conducts comprehensive evaluation on different datasets. Experimental results show that this framework is feasible in practical application, and the proposed network structure is superior to the existing methods in the accuracy of watermark removal.

articleTitle: Improvement strategy and statistical analysis of the failure of smart electric energy meter in power system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at several problems in the measurement process of electric energy meters under spot market conditions, an improvement strategy is proposed based on an in-depth analysis of the abnormal causes of smart meters. Firstly, perform statistical analysis on the failure of the disassembled electric energy meter to determine the three main failure modes, and propose improvement strategies for the three main failure modes. The measurement error analysis result shows that the error of the high-precision electric energy meter has a maximum jump of about 0.02%.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm Optimization and Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model of University Index System by Delphi and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As an important part of society, colleges and universities have a huge impact on promoting green development. With the continuous expansion of the scale of my country’s universities, the energy consumption of universities has also increased, and it has become an important part of my country’s terminal energy resource consumption that cannot be ignored. Building environment-friendly colleges and universities has important practical significance for furthering the construction of ecological civilization and realizing a beautiful China. This article explores the construction of an environmentally friendly index system for colleges and universities. By consulting related theoretical literature, and innovating the index system based on the national standard, the green and sustainable development are distinguished. Delphi and principal component analysis are synergistic the optimal value and calculation formula of the indicator. Finally, the construction of an environmentally friendly university of Nanjing Xiaozhuang University is evaluated, and the problems existing in the construction of an environmentally friendly university of Nanjing Xiaozhuang University are analyzed. Promote to more colleges and universities, produce practical significance.

articleTitle: Computer assisted design of smart ship safety controlling software based on leap motion and unity3D
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Starting from the frequent occurrence of ship safety accidents and the poor effect of single training form, this paper puts forward the ship safety training based on Leap Motion and Unity3D. It uses Unity3D to build virtual training scenes and uses Leap Motion instead of mouse and keyboard to carry out human-computer interaction. It realizes the virtual ship safety training based on the mode of clearance interaction, so as to improve the training effect and reduce accidents hard. This project mainly studies the application of virtual reality technology in ship safety training. Safety training is through the whole process, which greatly improves the enthusiasm of the trainers. With the help of strong immersive experience brought by virtual reality technology and new human-computer interaction technology, the trainers can experience the injury caused by the accident. So as to achieve a better training effect than the traditional training and solve the real life problems.

articleTitle: Maximum Similarity Directed Subgraph Searching Algorithm on Subjective Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The determination of similar subgraphs has always been a difficult point in the search of directed graphs. Existing algorithms are difficult to accurately describe the similarity of subgraphs. Therefore, we proposes a novel search algorithm for maximal similar directed subgraph based on subjective logic. The algorithm is based on isomorphic nodes, based on the similarity argument of subjective logic for graphics containing a few nodes, greedy algorithm is adopted to gradually expand the scale of similar subgraphs until it is lower than the preset threshold. Compared with other related algorithms, this algorithm makes use of subjective logic’s ability to accurately describe realistic arguments and uncertain reasoning, which makes the judgment of subgraph similarity more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Operation and Maintenance Technology of Substation Fault Recorder
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: For the current recorder operation and maintenance master station, only the waveform file can be accessed and the recorder status can be monitored, but remote operation and command issuance and execution cannot be realized. The conventional defects of the fault recorder in the substation need to be checked and dealt with on-site by the maintenance personnel, which is inefficient. This paper proposes that through the optimization and upgrading of the main station and the recorder software and hardware, and the installation of a remote restart auxiliary device in the station, the remote restart, remote reset and remote operation of the recorder can be realized, which can greatly improve the online operation rate of the equipment and improve the equipment transportation inspection efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transformer Vibration Signal Based on Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The chaos theory is applied to the analysis of the vibration signal on the surface of the transformer box. Collected the surface vibration data of a 110kV and 220kV online transformer box in Beijing. Reconstruct the phase space by calculating the delay time and embedding dimension. The largest Lyapunov exponents of the two transformers are nonnegative, which verifies that the transformer vibration is a chaotic system. The distribution of the correlation dimension, K entropy and other parameter characteristics of the chaotic characteristics of transformers with different voltage levels is obtained. The distribution of characteristic parameters of the transformer under different current conditions is analyzed, which provides a method for transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Database Mining Information System Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the development and design of embedded systems, using the database SQLite to maintain and manage the batch data of the system can greatly improve the operating efficiency of the program, but SQLite itself has no security mechanism support. We design and implement an encryption module based on artificial intelligence algorithms based on analyzing computer system application requirements, encryption system and SQLite application characteristics, architecture, and development technology. The result shows that after SQLite adds encryption function, the security can be improved.

articleTitle: Application of big data technology in the research and development of emergency supplies based on bibliometric and knowledge map analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to analyze the research status of international emergency supplies, A total of 191 literatures on emergency supplies included in the WOS core database from 2010 to 2021 were selected as research samples, by using CiteSpace and VosViewer software to draw network knowledge map, the topic content and frontier hot spots in this field are analyzed. The result shows, the research in this field shows a fluctuating growth trend. Beijing Jiaotong University and “International Journal of Production Economics” are the institutions and journals with the largest number of papers in this field respectively. The research content in this field mainly includes: management support and supplies distribution, emergency decision and facility location, emergency supplies preparation and safety, humanitarian logistics of disaster relief, and disaster emergency management theory. Future research may focus on the fusion innovation of multi-algorithm and multi-requirement modeling and so on.

articleTitle: Geographic Information System and Big Data Technology Applied in Low Carbon Logistics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, China’s logistics industry is in a period of renewal and iteration. In the context of development strategy “Carbon neutral”, a lot of insiders and scholars attach great importance to how to make logistics industry develop more healthily and stably. This article analyzes this issue from the context of carbon logistics development, growth trend and dilemma, and proposes a solution to the current situation to promote the development of low carbon logistics.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Medical Decision Mathematical Model by Improved Analytic Hierarchy Process and OLS Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the service innovation and the richness of service diversity, the focus of online medical services has shifted from early service adoption to service management. The priority model of medical equipment renewal decision is established based on the analytic hierarchy process of group decision-making, in order to improve the efficiency of decision-making and provide new ideas for the renewal management of medical equipment. Genetic algorithm is used to analyze the influence of the combination of different control parameters on the optimization process of the model, in order to obtain the optimal combination parameters of the model, and then optimize the decision under the optimal combination parameters to maximize the number of equipment that urgently needs to be updated. Therefore, through the understanding of hospital health technology assessment (HB-HTA) standards, combined with the actual situation of the hospital, based on signal theory to explore the impact of doctor service diversity and service quality signals on patient selection decisions in the context of online medical services. Collect the second-hand data from the doctor's online platform, and use the propensity score matching method and OLS regression method to study the impact of service diversity on patient decision-making in different situations. The model is applied to the monitor of a tertiary hospital, the RPI is obtained and the corresponding update strategy is determined. The combination of GDM-AHP and medical equipment renewal can not only improve the efficiency of medical equipment renewal decision-making, but also make the decision result more convincing. The number of types of services has a significant positive impact on patients' decision-making. at the same time, doctors' heat and service price play an effective positive role in adjusting. The conclusion of the study provides important practical value for doctors and online medical platform. This kind of equipment investment decision-making model, which determines the priority of business needs, technology, economic evaluation and budget, serves as the basis for hospital scientific decision-making.

articleTitle: Application of Information Digitization in SPOC Blending Learning by Internet Remote Video Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: SPOC, meaning “small-scale limited online course”, is a more refined and niche type of online open course than MOOC. SPOC makes full use of the rapidly developing Internet information technology, organically combines the advantages of Internet online teaching with traditional offline teaching to conduct synchronous teaching from online and offline Spaces, and broaden students’ learning channels, expand the coverage of teaching, and improve the quality of classroom teaching. Based on the definition of SPOC and blending learning mode, this paper comprehensively analyzes the problems confronting colleges and universities. Based on this basis, the construction and application of SPOC-based blending learning model in tourism management majors are discussed.

articleTitle: IOT device identification solution based on unsupervised to semi-supervised
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of 5G, the types and numbers of IoT terminals will become more abundant. Different types of IoT terminals have large differences in behavior and network requirements. The refined operation and maintenance based on IoT application scenarios is an important for operators. The identification of the IoT terminal type is the first step to achieve refined operation and maintenance. In order to address difficulties of identifying IOT terminal type and lack of labeled data, this paper proposes a solution to fulfill the IoT terminal type based on network data using AI algorithm. This solution is to extract the behavioral patterns of IoT terminals based on network data, use a combination of semi-supervised and unsupervised methods to fulfill the labeling of training data, and use AI algorithms to identify IoT terminal type. The verification results show that the accuracy in identifying bus IoT from the APN of the IoT terminal hybrid access reaches 97.87%, which proved the effectiveness of the solution.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Education Using Neural Network and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The prosperity of a country is always accompanied by the prosperity of education, and higher education is a very important part of the civic education system. Therefore, the paper set up the evaluation and prediction model of higher education, and apply it to six countries——United States, Germany, Japan, Australia, South Africa and India, to put forward reasonable measures and analyze the impact. In order to evaluate the health status of higher education system, the paper established CIPP health evaluation model based on PSO-BP neural network. The paper use 18 indicators and the relationship betthe paperen health status and related indicators to establish a clear framework of “foundation input process performance”. The index set is divided into four dimensions, according to the principal component analysis method to determine the extraction of four primary indicators. Through particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize the neural network, the paper use a PSO-BP neural network algorithm to find out the health status of higher education. Our model is applied to six countries. The results show that the higher education health scores of the United States, Germany, Japan, Australia, South Africa and India are 4.95, 3.10, 2.88, 3.12, 1.38 and 1.78 respectively. According to this, it is concluded that the higher education health of the United States is excellent, while that of South Africa and India should be improved.

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Load Computer Dynamic Forecast Model of Integrated Energy in Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The integrated energy system of an industrial park is a system that manages, transforms, stores and consumes various energy sources. Therefore, short-term load forecasting plays an important role in the stable operation of the system. This paper builds a short-term load forecasting model for industrial parks on the basis of BP deep belief network theory, and sets the structure and parameters of the model. After offline training, the park’s electricity and gas loads are predicted, and the error satisfies the system Requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Practice of Computer 3D Simulation and Virtual Reality Technology in Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The language learning community based on the virtual network platform Second Life uses 3D virtual network technology to construct a virtual simulation teaching situation and open up the network communication space. This has opened up a new space for English learning. This paper applies the polarization 3D virtual reality technology to the courseware design process of computer hardware assembly in vocational colleges, which effectively solves the lack of spatial interactivity of teaching resources, stimulates students’ interest in learning, and strengthens practical skills.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Assessment Model of Dual Impact of Technological Progress on Carbon Emissions by Cloud Computing and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Technological progress is one of the most important factors affecting carbon emissions. Analyzing the impact of technological progress on carbon emissions can provide policy recommendations and theoretical basis for China's technological development, economic growth and environmental protection. Based on the conclusions obtained by the researchers’ analysis, we summarize the positive and negative effects of technological progress on reducing carbon emissions, and emphasizes that the development of low-carbon technologies can optimize the energy structure and increase the utilization rate of clean energy and new energy, and finally achieve the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutrality.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent assessment model of the development path research of Erdos by geographic information system and big data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, China's rural tourism has developed rapidly, and the development of agritourism has shown strong momentum and taken a place in rural tourism. The city of Ordos is located in the western region of China, and rural tourism in the course of its booming development, has also brought negative impact on the ecological environment of the countryside. Based on the interpretation of the concept and role of ecotourism, this paper analyzes the problems in the sustainable development of Erdos Nongjiale tourism on the basis of the development of Erdos Nongjiale tourism as an example, and proposes the path of sustainable development of Erdos Nongjiale in the context of green environment protection in the new erea, in order to provide reference for the sustainable development of Erdos Nongjiale tourism.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Line Loss Data System in Power Grid through Abnormal Identification of Line Loss Index
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The article designs a 10kV medium and low voltage distribution network synchronization line loss optimization system, which is composed of three parts: data acquisition unit, transmission unit and analysis unit. Among them, GPRS public network and 230M wireless private network are used as information transmission channels; the data analysis unit is composed of data reading, topology analysis and line loss calculation. Aiming at the problems of serious data missing in the current electricity collection process, large errors in the simultaneous line loss and calculation process, and low reliability, in the process of line loss calculation, a hierarchical node identification strategy is introduced, and a support vector machine is proposed. The intelligent identification method of load nodes can effectively and quickly obtain the injection current of various load nodes, thereby reducing the line loss error caused by non-synchronous data.

Author Keywords: line loss in the same period

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Digitization in the Study of Functional Exercises System under Expert Database Diagnostic Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Purpose: The paper explores the clinical effects of acupuncture and massage combined with functional exercise in patients with lumbar disc herniation and designs an acupuncture treatment system based on expert database diagnostic technology to assist acupuncture and massage work. Methods: The paper selected 60 patients with lumbar disc herniation admitted from January 2018 to December 2019 as the study, and randomly divided them into a control group and a test group, 30 cases in each group according to the admission sequence number. The control group was given massage therapy, and the test group was given acupuncture and massage combined with rehabilitation training to compare the therapeutic effects of the two programs. At the same time, design an acupuncture treatment system based on expert data diagnosis. Results: The total effective treatment rate in the experimental group was 95.0%, which was better than 72.5% in the control group. The difference was statistically significant $(\mathrm{P}\lt 0.05)$. Conclusion: The treatment effect of acupuncture and massage combined with rehabilitation training for patients with lumbar intervertebral disc herniation is more significant, and it is worth recommending. The system designed in the article is based on the theory of traditional Chinese medicine and acupuncture, integrating symbolic measurement theory, computer technology, and electrical technology. The leading development and integration are (1) Expert database that can be automatically diagnosed: (2) Imitating classical acupuncture techniques the production of the electro-acupuncture method. This system realizes the integration of diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Key Technology in the Development of Smart SMS Application Management Platform of Yunnan Power Grid Company
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Smart SMS application can effectively promote the electronic service channel of Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd. by combining online promotion and offline drainage in a new way. In this context, this work first analyzed the application scope of the intelligent SMS application management platform and its implementation technical route, then discussed the integration technology of the system, and finally gave the security scheme of the system and its operation and maintenance suggestions. Based on the relevant SMS scenarios in the existing marketing business applications, artificial intelligence technology was used to intelligently transform the text message content, text message number, etc. The corresponding research results are helpful for Yunnan Power Grid to realize business closed loop and improve user experience.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Modeling Micro-Curriculum Integrating Using Computer Simulation under Internet Background
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article proposes a simulation method that uses Simulink to implement a mathematical modeling hybrid control system to assist college students in the reform of mathematical modeling teaching. The actual controlled object in the control system is described by a nonlinear continuous system constructed by a continuous Simulink module. Simultaneously, a combination of Simulink module and M function is used to trigger the subsystem to simulate the digital processing unit in the closed-loop control system with the rising edge of the signal. That is, the digital filtering and controller part can truly simulate the process of periodically collecting and processing data, and finally realize the simulation of the mathematical modeling hybrid control system. The closed-loop simulation results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Support Vector Machine Model based on Mixed Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the national economy, the power system has higher and higher requirements for power supply stability. The traditional manual inspection method is dangerous, inefficient, and has poor data timeliness. Therefore, more and more people study how to put UAVs into power grid inspection. However, there is no good method to effectively process and predict the data collected by UAVs. To solve this problem, this paper uses the combination of mixed data prediction and support vector machine to predict the environmental data and judge the sensor state. For the final performance of the model, this paper chooses ACC as the standard. Experiments show that the prediction result of the model is indeed more accurate.

articleTitle: Design and research of smart and accurate information push system for atomized products through algorithm optimization and big data technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper researches and designs a precise pushing system for fog cultivation products based on the current situation of fog cultivation products industry, based on big data related technology. It not only solves the problem of product overload but also realizes accurate marketing for users. It improves the user stickiness of users in the fog cultivation horticulture industry and makes it faster and more convenient for users to obtain various consumables in the process of fog cultivation, which makes the industry develop steadily and lays a certain technical foundation for building a fog cultivation product sales and technical service platform integrating resource distribution, technical support, after-sales service and online feedback.

articleTitle: Research on the Automatic Tuning Servo System of Short Wave Transmitter Based on EtherCAT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The automatic tuning system is an indispensable part of the short-wave transmitter and undertakes the work of frequency adjustment. This article uses EtherCAT real-time Ethernet communication in the servo control system. According to the precise tuning drive requirements, a servo control system based on EtherCAT was designed. After completing the software and hardware design and programming of the master and slave stations, a servo control system based on EtherCAT communication was built and tested to verify the EtherCAT servo the performance superiority of the control system.

articleTitle: Research on DOA Estimation Based on Spatial Smoothing Algorithm and Optimal Smoothing Times
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: MUSIC algorithm is widely used to estimate the direction of arrival (DOA) of spatial signals because of its high estimation accuracy and low SNR (Signal to Noise Ratio). However, for non-coherent signals, the traditional MUSIC algorithm cannot make accurate estimation. This paper starts with the principles of MUSIC algorithm, carries out mathematical derivation and simulation experiments, and uses the MUSIC algorithm based on spatial smoothing to estimate the coherent DOA of signals. The relationship between the optimal smoothing times and coherent signals is proposed, and the relational expression of the optimal smoothing times is found under the condition of one-dimensional uniform linear array, more antenna arrays and less coherent signals. The simulation results show that the relational expression has good performance.

articleTitle: Design of Face Recognition Temperature Detector Based on YoloV2 Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Because of the new champions league epidemic raged in the whole world, a variety of inconvenience to people’s production, life, at present, although the effective control of domestic outbreak, but the epidemic still cannot relax, requires a lot of manpower, material resources, financial resources, in particular schools, hospitals, shopping malls and other crowded places, as the main representation of the new champions league patients body fever, Temperature detection is needed for initial screening of COVID-19 patients. Based on the above reasons, a non-contact, long-distance body temperature detector was designed to detect the temperature of candidates to avoid problems such as temperature misdetection, false alarm, and omission. The method of manual verification by invigilators was changed, and the YoloV2 algorithm was used to obtain identity in real time and automatically. Validation results. This article first analyzes the existing problems of the current body temperature detector and the market demand for epidemic prevention and control, and then designs the non-contact, remote body temperature measurement and face recognition functions of the body temperature detector. Finally, it has been actually verified to meet the design requirements, especially for the success rate of face recognition of blurred images is over 74%. With the continuous improvement and upgrade of functions, it will have high engineering application value.

articleTitle: Matrix Representations of One-dimensional Map Folding and Single-Vertex Flat Folding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: When it comes to investigating practical subjects, representations are usually viewed as a beneficial approach for accurately and scientifically studying them. However, due to the concern on topological properties, traditional research in origami prefer to explain a folding process more geometrically and algorithmically. In this work, we offer novel matrix representations for one-dimensional map folding and single-vertex flat folding. Besides the high efficiency they show in solving specific folding problems, these matrix representations further indicate the linear structure of the overlap of layers, which is desired to be integrated into the framework of category theory.

articleTitle: Eyes Move, Drones Move Explore the Feasibility of Various Eye Movement Control Intelligent Drones
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nearly all drones on the market are controlled by joystick controllers. The advantage of this traditional control method is that the operator can accurately control or adjust the flight angle and distance of the drone, but there also exists a disadvantage: without practice, the operator will easily mix up the corresponding function of each joystick and hardly tell the direction of flight. Therefore, drones need a new type of control method. As a device invented at the end of the 20th century, eye trackers are not a completely new concept.
