Eye trackers are currently limited to expensive psychological research, but this type of instrument has little practical value for ordinary consumers. However, the drones can be effectively combined with the eye tracker and take full advantage of both equipment. This article explores the possibility of combining eye trackers with drones, and in particular, explores whether eye trackers can easily and accurately control drones. The experiments will be performed to see if the accuracy and speed of the drone will be guaranteed when using the eye tracker to control the drone, and if the eye movement control method can help the user faster To achieve the instructions they want to accomplish when compared with the original control method of the drone, Image process algorithms, which belong to a branch of Artificial intelligence (AI), the most potential computer science tool in the 21st century, can complete numerous equation learning tasks. It is a low-cost and efficient exploration to apply the human eye recognition framework (Dlib and OpenCV) to real-time detection of eye movements to control the drones.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Joint Operation Data Management Platform for Space-Ground Integrated Information Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the diversity and intelligence of modern warfare, new technologies such as the Internet of things and cloud computing are gradually applied to the military field. Many research institutions at home and abroad have successively proposed the concept of “combat cloud”. Space-Ground integrated information network is an important infrastructure to ensure China’s military security and economic development, is an important guarantee for the realization of military and civilian integration strategy, is the inevitable trend of the development of new era network technology. The integrated network includes a variety of complex networks, it will inevitably generate massive amounts of data in the network, such as satellite network data, battlefield environment data, intelligence resource data, etc. With the increasing development of the network, these data will inevitably show explosive growth, how to effectively manage these data will become a new problem. This article is oriented to the Space-Ground integrated information network, preliminarily designed the architecture of the joint operation data management platform, aims to store and manage combat data efficiently and provide effective combat support for modern warfare.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer VR Technology in the Three-Dimensional Virtual Landscape Design by 3dsMAX Modeling Software
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to ensure the rationality of garden landscape design, it is of great practical significance to simulate the planning effect. Aiming at the problems existing in the two traditional garden landscape planning effect simulation systems, a new garden landscape planning effect simulation system is designed on the basis of virtual reality technology. Here, 3dsMAX and ArcGIS software are used for three-dimensional virtual landscape design, 3dsMAX modeling software is fully utilized to build a three-dimensional platform, and the system design is realized through ArcGIS software. Through data acquisition and model establishment, the feature classes of all models are converted into point features, and the 3D model layer data composed of point features is imported into the ArcGIS 3D system to establish a digital system. The three-dimensional model is integrated with the GIS platform to realize the three-dimensional visualization of the landscape, and complete the management and display functions of the system data, as well as the functions of spatial information query and spatial analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Hardware Manufacturing Based on Computer Big Data Bus Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The article adopts the bus technology to build the automatic test equipment, including the intelligent interface, the data acquisition system composed of the bus module instrument and the automatic test software with VEE as the development environment. The intelligent interface successfully solves the mutual isolation of the detection signals provided by the test object; the use of the bus module instrument greatly improves the hardware reliability of the entire automatic test equipment; the use of VEE to develop automatic test software reduces the complexity of software development, Shorten the development cycle and ensure the reliability of the automatic test software.

articleTitle: Inertial Measurement Unit Installation Accuracy Measurement Method and Result Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The installation accuracy of the inertial measurement device determines the accuracy of the measurement. Therefore, the inertial measurement unit requires high installation accuracy. However, for some installation environments with limited filling space, the inertial measurement unit faces the problem of measurement difficulties. Aiming at the limited loading space, irregular shape of the inertial measurement unit and inconvenient measurement, this paper proposes a method to replace the measurement with a reference surface, which realizes the installation accuracy measurement of the inertial measurement unit in a small space.

articleTitle: Mathematical model establishment and simulation analysis of the spread of COVID-19 epidemic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to explore the intrinsic laws of the spread of COVID-19 across the globe, this paper applies partial differential equation and related theories to model and carry out theoretical analysis and numerical analysis. Firstly, by adding the free diffusion term to the traditional ordinary differential SEIRS epidemic model, the corresponding partial differential epidemic model is established. Secondly, the basic reproduction number R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is calculated by using operator theory and spectral method, and it is testified that R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is monotonically decreasing with respect to the diffusion coefficients of the exposed and infected individuals. Furthermore, we examine the asymptotic property of the endemic equilibrium with respect to the diffusion coefficient. Finally, we take the Canadian epidemic data as an example to carry out numerical simulation and parameter sensitivity analysis by applying difference method and BP neural network, the results show that strengthening the isolation of susceptible and exposed individuals, reducing the infection rate of infected individuals will help to better control the large-scale outbreak of the epidemic.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model of Fish Migration Geographic Information by ARMA and IDW Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: “The great opportunity for the rise of the Netherlands in history is to defeat Britain in the war for herring”. To this day, herring remains the most important source of fisheries in Britain. We are happy to help Scotland do a better job in herring fishing. In recent years, the problem of global warming is becoming a serious global challenge. In 2019, the global ocean temperature reached its peak, which was the alarm for all humankind once again. When temperature changes are too great for these species, some fishes will move to seek other habitats better suited to their present and future living and reproductive success. This change will affect the development of the fishing industry. Therefore, we establish some models to solve this problem. We divide the Scottish sea area into five areas and take five sampling points in each area. Based on the temperature data of the sample points, we build ARMA (p, q) time series to predict the situation of these sample points in the next 50 years. We find that the temperature of the Scottish sea area will continue to rise, but the seasonal characteristics will not change (the highest in August, the lowest in February); then, we apply the univariate non-linear regression method to explore the relationship between temperature and fishing volume, and we find that 13.3°C is the most suitable for catching herring. Then we use the IDW method to fit the temperature of the Scottish sea area and make the isotherm. Since the migration direction of the fish is approximately perpendicular to the isotherm, we get the approximate position and future migration direction of the fish. At present, Peterhead, the largest fishing ground on the east coast of Scotland, is in the upstream of fish migration, while Maillarg on the west coast is in its golden fishing season. In the future, fish will continue to migrate north.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Accounting Information System Using Web Service-Oriented Intelligent Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Research on the intelligence of information security auditing systems is currently a research hotspot in the field of information security, and the application of techniques such as pattern recognition and data mining in information security auditing has received extensive attention. Through in-depth research on service-oriented architecture, WS-CAS is a Web service-oriented computer audit system model, developed a system prototype supporting Web Service under the Internet environment, and built a computer audit platform with a service-oriented architecture under the Internet environment to verify the service-oriented architecture The feasibility of the computer audit model.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model and Research on the Mathematical Impact of Hiring Decisions Using Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of technology, the widespread application of robots and big data increasingly has an important impact on firm’s hiring decisions. This article aims to investigate the relationship between firms’ inflation expectations and employment decisions. Specifically, the main findings of this paper can be summarized as follows, first, the panel fixed effect model is used to study the relationship between corporate inflation expectations and corporate employment decisions, and it is found that inflation expectations is negatively connected with the employment; second, through the empirical study of the sample groups, it is found that changes in the size of employees of large enterprises and state-owned enterprises are more sensitive to inflation expectations. Moreover, we make a comprehensive discussion for the results which may benefits the central bank to guild inflation expectations.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Design and Implementation of Feature Smart Tests Retrieval System through Scientific Literature
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: It is believed that pancreatic cancer has a very high fatality rate and a low early detection rate, with minimal progress in the treatment, a dismal overall prognosis, and exceedingly difficult diagnosis or early detection at a curable stage. Here, we develop one new method based on informatics to confirm the related clinical testing terms with the disease from four different perspectives i.e. risk assessment, diagnosis, treatment and prognosis. In addition, we present a work flow for prioritizing the tests by combining with the disease-to-genes database Orphanet, clinical physical examination index, biomedical literature from PubMed and an improved Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency model. Applying this approach to the publications involved with pancreatic cancer of PubMed, we can effectively obtain the related clinical testing index with early detection, detection, therapy andprognosis of pancreatic cancer. Findings present pertinent clinical tests for early detection, detection, therapy and prognosis of the disease which can effectively assist the early diagnosis and treatment of pancreatic cancer and provide reliable information support for the laboratory.

articleTitle: Application of network technology in power information and Communication Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: at present, China’s society has been in a state of rapid development, so people’s demand for power resources has also increased significantly, which also puts forward more stringent requirements for the development of electronic information and communication engineering. The power system should not only fully realize the actual needs of the current society, but also ensure the safety of residents in the process of power consumption, So that the construction of power system can be consistent with the development status of our society. In the process of in-depth research on the network technology in power information and communication engineering, we can find that there are still some problems such as unscientific network structure and low transmission quality. Therefore, we should carry out more in-depth exploration on the application of network technology in power information and communication engineering, so as to improve the stability of power information and communication.

articleTitle: Analysis on Length Correction Coefficient of Cross Members in the New Code of Power Transmission Line Tower Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The newly implemented technical code for design of overhead transmission line tower structures (DL /T5486-2020) revised the calculation length correction coefficient K of tower crossing materials. Through the comparison between the new and old specifications and the calculation length correction coefficient K of tower crossing materials in European and American standards, the qualitative impact of the implementation of the new specification on the calculation results of tower crossing materials is determined. The results show that the new regulation expands the range of calculation length correction of cross material under tension and compression, and increases the value of correction coefficient under simultaneous compression.

articleTitle: Improving the flying stability performance via the biomimetic sinusoidal leading edge
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Leveraging theoretical analysis and experimental field flights, this paper investigated the root cause of the long haunting instability problem that found in F2B aero model plane’s precision flight. Inspired by humpback whale’s unique flipper structure and tubercles on its leading edge, in this research, this special structure was modeled into a definitive sinusoidal leading edge for the model plane. It was simulated with CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) software, i.e. Fluent, to prove its effectiveness in increasing critical angle of attack and delay stall. This airfoil is commonly used in the control-line model plane. Two sets of sinusoidal leading edge were fabricated and installed on the plane for experiments. The actual effectiveness and differences between normal leading edge and sinusoidal leading edge were then tested and verified in the real flights.

articleTitle: Application and Development Trend of Computer Aided Art Design Using Image Recognition and Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: After the twenty-first century, China’s science and technology, culture and positive value have been developed rapidly, and the comprehensive national power has been continuously improved, in this environment, modern art design has also made breakthrough achievements, and has been revitalized and energized. But even so, there are still some problems and drawbacks that have not yet been resolved. It is on this basis that this paper makes an in-depth study of modern art design in China. Firstly, the concept and connotation of modern art design are introduced, then the current situation of modern art design in China in the Internet era and the related problems are analyzed, and finally the future development trend of modern art design in the current era is discussed in the light of the actual situation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of song text generation for smart speakers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, more and more artificial intelligence (AI) technologies have been receiving increasing research interest with our lives. In fact, Face recognition, sweeping robots, driverless and so on are closely related to our lives, bringing a lot of convenience to our lives and work. Meanwhile, another AI technology, smart speakers have slowly come into our view in recent years. Especially smart speakers this cake can be hotspot issues in the field of artificial intelligence. Subsequently, smart speakers have many functions, such as listening to the radio, check the weather, intelligent reminders, control of home appliances, etc., but most people are used to enjoy music with smart speakers. Generally speaking, when the user and smart speaker dialogue to achieve the process of playing music, the current practice of most manufacturers is to directly play the song the user wants to hear, or insert the style of fixed text before playing the song. In order to bring users a better music experience and let them understand the connotation of the song more deeply, this paper intends to adopt a radio-like approach, inserting some personalized song text before playing music on the smart speaker. This radio-like song text not only increases the user’s music experience, but also allows users to use music as a support to express their personal feelings. However, music text information has been growing exponentially in recent years and people are creating a large amount of music-related texts every day, hence, how to extract important contents as personalized song texts from this huge amount of data is still a pressing problem. Therefore, the topic of this paper is to use the Seq2Seq+Attention model based on Tensorflow [1] to automatically obtain short, relevant, and personalized song texts from the song corpus efficiently.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Informatization and Blended Smart Learning Cloud Platform Based on Unipus and Online Video Transmission Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To improve college students’ vocabulary competence, a blended teaching of affixation based on Unipus (a smart teaching and learning cloud platform) is designed and carried out by taking language output as the learning goal as well as driving means. Some insights are given into students’ vocabulary study by combing input learning with output application via this cloud platform. The blended teaching design and practice undertaken is to give insight to vocabulary teaching and learning from a distinctive perspective of education informatization.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on output characteristics of wind farm group
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The centralized grid connection of large wind farm clusters has an impact on the safe operation of the power system. The paper takes 10 wind power clusters in Gansu Province as the research object, and constructs capacity factor and its frequency distribution, capacity coefficient deviation, intermittency rate, correlation, simultaneous rate and other output characteristics indicators to analyze the output characteristics of wind power clusters respectively. This study is of reference significance for improving the scheduling operation of large wind farm clusters, and provides guidance for wind farm planning and design.

articleTitle: The Application of Factor Analysis and Loading Matrix in Computer Intelligent Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Grades
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: There is a need to have a comprehensive evaluation on the students’ grade scientifically and reasonably in the field of teaching management. Firstly, this paper use the method of factor analysis and cluster analysis to establish comprehensive evaluated model. A empirical analysis on the marks of 32 students in the department of mathematics and information science was given. Secondly, the comprehensive ranking of the students based on three main factors extracted from 11 subjects were given. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of the students in various disciplines were also analyzed objectively. The results provided a good reference for the comprehensive quality training of the students and improving the teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Radio Frequency Identification Technology in Intelligent Maritime Supervision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The increasing volume of domestic and foreign trade brings new challenges to the efficiency and safety supervision of transportation. With the rapid development of Internet technology, it has opened up a new era of intelligent Internet of Things and the modern marine Internet of Vessels. Radio Frequency Identification technology strengthens the intelligent navigation and management of ships through the unique identification function of “label is object, object is label”. Intelligent Internet of Vessels can achieve the function of “limited electronic monitoring and unlimited electronic deterrence” combined with marine big data and Cyber Physical Systems, and further improve the level of modern maritime supervision and service.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of CAPWAP Disconnection Service Maintenance in Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The campus network adopts FIT AP+AC mode in order to improve the use efficiency of smart campus network, improve and enhance the level of campus information, and build a campus network with wide coverage, high speed, easy management and more security. This paper introduces the working principle of CAPWAP protocol, analyzes the realization process of CAPWAP disconnection business maintenance function. The test of this system shows that users can maintain normal communication when switching between different APs.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Reconstruction of Remote Sensing Images Based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the methods of super-resolution image reconstruction that based on deep learning have become a hot topic in research of computer vision. The methods of super-resolution image reconstruction that based on the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) are not controlled in network generation, the models are easy to collapse, the generalization ability is undesirable, and the time complexity degree is too high. To fill these gaps, we propose a super-resolution image reconstruction method based on the GAN of encoding and decoding, which improves the quality of image reconstruction. First of all, our approach uses a design network with regularized structure to avoid model collapse. Then we build a generation network structure that based on encoding and decoding to suppress the uncontrollable defects of GAN network generated images. Finally, in the last layer of the generator, $\mathrm{N}^{\star}\mathrm{N}$ convolutional feature layer is included to replace the Softmax layer, which speeds up the training of the model. The experimental results show that the super-resolution remote sensing image reconstructed by the proposed method has higher reconstruction quality and better generalization ability in the DOTA training data sets. At the same time, the image reconstruction process can take much less time.

articleTitle: Tibetan News Text Classification Based on Multi-features Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the main research method of Tibetan text classification research is to use Tibetan words and Tibetan syllables as the basic representation features of the entire text, and then use Deep Neural Network models such as CNN and LSTM to complete the text classification research. Under normal circumstances, Tibetan news texts are composed of the headlines and the content. The news headlines summarize the news content in a short text sequence. That is to say, relative to the content of a news text, the headlines have more important weight information. Due to the short text sequence length of the headlines, there will be sparse features. This paper proposes to use both syllables and words features as the basic representation objects of headlines, so that the convolutional neural network model can extract more comprehensive semantic features of the headlines. For the task of Tibetan news texts classification, the experimental method in this paper is to simultaneously express the basic characteristics of the headlines and the content of the Tibetan news text at the words and syllables. Then after feature vectorization, the CNN network is used to complete the text classification. The research results show that the classification method proposed in this paper has achieved good classification results on the test set of experimental corpus.

articleTitle: Primary side optimization control of heating station based on double-delay depth deterministic policy gradient
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the phenomenon of mismatch between heat supply and customer demand at heating station, an optimal control model for the primary side of heating station based on double-delay depth deterministic policy gradient (TD3) is proposed. The heat load forecasting model and heat supply model are established by using temporal convolutional network (TCN) and long short-term memory network (LSTM) and combined with TD3 model to realize the optimal solution of water supply flow on the primary side. Using historical data from a heating station in Baotou to verify the model, the results show that the TD3-based primary-side optimal control model of the heating station basically satisfies the on-demand heat supply and improves the heat utilization rate.

articleTitle: Information system construction and research on the layout of the old city of Beijing using spatial syntax and heat map
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Beijing historical city has both history and life atmosphere, and undertakes modern urban functions such as commercial office, but with the improvement of residents’ living standards, commercial facilities can not meet the living needs and environmental requirements. The quantitative method of analyzing urban space is of great significance for studying the accessibility of commercial facilities. This paper takes the west area of Tiantan of Tianqiao Street, Xicheng District, Beijing, uses the spatial syntactic theory and research method, and quantitatively studies the accessibility of its commercial facilities from the commercial area, traffic and human flow. On this basis, combined with the accessibility of the commercial facilities and the commercial potential, discuss the planning and layout of the commercial facilities in the region, and analyze the commercial potential points combined with the field research, and put forward the corresponding improvement strategies. In order to provide new research methods and ideas for the planning and layout of commercial facilities in the historical urban areas.

articleTitle: A Primal-Dual Algorithm for Distributed Sparse Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of sparse principal component analysis (SPCA), which is an extension of principal component analysis (PCA) for a sparser subspace of the original data. We propose a fully decentralized algorithm based on the primal-dual technique to solve SPCA in a distributed manner. The proposed algorithm has the ability to handle massively large datasets stored in multiple machines. The proposed method is shown to converge to stationary solutions of SPCA. Numerical experiments are provided to demonstrate the efficacy of our distributed primal-dual approach.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Comparison of Fuel Consumption for a Heavy-duty Diesel Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, chassis dynamometer (CD), Engine-In-the-Loop (EIL) methodology and Vehicle Energy Consumption Calculation Tool (VECTO) were used to study the fuel consumption characteristics of a heavy-duty truck at Chinese version of the World Harmonized Vehicle Cycle (C-WTVC). The results of the vehicle speed followability show that the average of absolute values of the vehicle velocity deviations between the three methods and C-WTVC regulation are 0.916, 0.883 and 0.733 km/h, respectively. The CD test has the largest deviation, and the VECTO simulation has the smallest deviation. The total distance and total cycle power of the three methods are not much different. However, the power of urban and motorway have large difference. The weighted fuel consumption of C-WTVC of CD test, EIL test and VECTO simulation are 14.93, 15.17 and 16.2 L/100km respectively. Compared with CD test, the EIL test fuel consumption is 1.61% higher, and the VECTO simulation fuel consumption is S.51% higher.

articleTitle: Sender Reputation Construction method using Sender Authentication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Spam is not just annoying, it is a serious problem that causes security problems. Mail filters are effective and widely used as anti-spam measures. However, spam senders are also becoming more sophisticated in their content and transmission methods, and countermeasures are becoming more difficult. In addition, if the mail filter makes a false judgment, there is also the problem that the necessary mail will not be delivered. In this paper, we propose a method for constructing sender reputation using sender authentication technologies. The sender of the forwarded mail is used as a method to determine the legitimate mail server. To determine the sender of the forwarded mail, use the authentication result of SPF and DKIM authentication. In addition, we propose a method using DKIM’s block list as a countermeasure against forwarded spam. We used these methods to validate the sender reputation using the mails we actually received.

articleTitle: Bilateral Symmetry Detection in Perspective Based on Vanish Features
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Symmetry detection is an important research field in image analysis and computer vision. It plays an important role in object match, recognition and location. However, the change of perspective projection angle increases the difficulty of symmetry detection. Therefore, it is of great significance to detect the symmetry of objects under perspective projection. Current feature point-based methods mostly use multiple sets of matched point pairs to detect the symmetry axis line, which not only introduces massive calculation but also interference between feature point pairs. Hence, we propose a novel feature point match-based symmetry axes lines detection method of planar graphs in perspective. This approach detects matched pairs based on the BEBLID descriptor and AdaLAM mismatch removal, and adopts binocular cameras to get a potential symmetry axis line from a pair of matched points, avoiding the influence of other matched points. Experimental results show that this method can achieve accurate and efficient detection of symmetry axis.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Gesture Recognition Rehabilitation System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Gesture recognition is an important way of human-computer interaction. In view of the problems such as the single function of rehabilitation equipment, repetitive and boring movements in the training process, and slow recovery process, a gesture recognition rehabilitation system based on deep learning was proposed. Firstly, the key technologies of computer vision such as image acquisition, segmentation, smooth processing, classification and recognition are introduced. Secondly, the implementation details of gesture rehabilitation system are emphasized. Gesture sample data of people of different ages and genders were collected by camera to establish a rehabilitation gesture database. The convolutional neural network training model and PyQt graphical interface were used to build a rehabilitation system. The experimental results show that the system is reliable and accurate, which can not only improve the interest and enthusiasm of patients to rehabilitation training, but also is cheaper than other rehabilitation equipment and has a broader application prospect.

articleTitle: Design of DC/DC Converter for HVDC Aeronautic Electrical Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The aviation industry High-voltage DC (HVDC) power system is the future of the modern aviation electric power system due to their light weight and high reliability. In the applications of aeronautic DC/DC conversion, the LLC topology has been widely adopted due to its high efficiency and high power density. To satisfy safety, high power quality and wide range voltage regulation in aeronautic applications, the most frequently chosen topology is a dual stage DC/DC converter composed of LLC and other DC/DC converter. In this article, a single stage LLC resonant converter with an extra filtering inductor has been studied to increase power density and efficiency, while maintaining safety and power quality. A270V/2SV2kW LLC resonant converter has been simulated to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Smart Audit Evaluation Index System Using Analytic Hierarchy Process and Intelligent Numerical Computation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The evaluation method of management audit is an indispensable and important part of the audit process. It is the core and key to the success of management audit. It is also the focus of common concern by the audit unit and the auditee. This paper uses the analytic hierarchy process to construct the evaluation index system of management audit, which is helpful to correctly guide the development of management audit practice and improve work efficiency.

Author Keywords: evaluation index system analytic hierarchy process

articleTitle: Analysis on the Live Broadcast for Agricultural Products by Computer Remote Video Technology under the Background of Internet plus Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of market economy, people’s demand for agricultural products is rising year by year, which brings new opportunities and challenges to marketing work. Especially under the current background of Internet plus model, traditional marketing strategies can no longer meet the needs of agricultural development, and only by accelerating innovation and reform can we increase the sales of agricultural products. Live broadcast marketing model is a product of the development of the Internet, more in line with the current personalized needs of people, making the current marketing of agricultural products into a new stage, accelerating the transformation and upgrading of agricultural production. This paper analyzes the current situation of live broadcast marketing of agricultural products under the background of Internet plus model, proposes the impact and problems of live broadcast marketing of agricultural products on the industry under the background of Internet plus model, and explores the strategy of live broadcast marketing of agricultural products under the background of Internet plus model.

articleTitle: Deep Recurrent Neural Network with Sharing Weights for Solving High-Dimensional PDEs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Solving high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) is a nontrivial problem. The traditional deep-learning algorithm may provide a potential approach to sovle this problem, but rather inefficiently. This paper constructs a novel PDE solver, by integrating the mechanism of sharing weights and recurrent neural network into the existing PDE solver with deep learning. The new solver is parsimonious in structure and efficient in operating. Numerical results show that, compared with the existing solver, the efficiency and accuracy of our new solver for high-dimensional Allen-Cahn equations is increased by 1.2 times and by one order of magnitude, respectively.

articleTitle: Information System Establishment and Big Data Digitization of Poverty Alleviation by Computer-Aided Network Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, Chinese poverty alleviation work has entered the stage of overcoming difficulties. Under the guidance of the "six precisions" proposed by General Secretary Xi Jinping, the integration of poverty alleviation data resources of various government departments is the top priority at the moment. Targeted financial poverty alleviation has improved the working mechanism involving the participation of local governments, relevant departments, village-level organizations, and financial institutions. It has integrated financial, fiscal, and industrial policies to build a comprehensive financial support system. Evaluation and application of results have a certain driving effect. Based on this research background, this paper proposes to design and implement a farmer credit management system based on the Hibernate + struts lightweight J2EE architecture. Compared with the traditional Web system based on a single frame architecture, the system is more efficient and maintainable in development. And scalability and other aspects have been greatly improved.

articleTitle: A Segmentation Algorithm for Overlapping Nuclear Track Image
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Solid state nuclear track detection technology is a significantly important nuclear technology based on measuring track density and geometric parameters, but particle track overlap hinders automatic identification, which seriously affects the measurement accuracy of track parameters. According to the characteristics of nuclear track images, a segmentation method for overlapping nuclear tracks is proposed, which includes three steps: preprocessing, background segmentation and overlap separation. In the preprocessing, bilateral filtering is used to denoise the image, and homomorphic filtering is used to improve the impact of uneven illumination. Subsequently, the background segmentation uses adaptive iterative threshold segmentation to obtain the initial contour of the track. Finally, mathematical morphology and an improved watershed algorithm are used to separate overlapping tracks. The result suggests that this method can correctly segment the tracks with different degrees of overlap and effectively improve the accuracy of automatic measurement.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Edge Computing Offloading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of the end users, the cloud computing service architecture is no longer suitable for low latency. At present, a large amount of electric and computing power is wasted. In this paper, we propose a two-stage task offloading strategy to ensure the quality of service while minimizing energy consumption. We use Google cluster data[l] and consider the dependencies between different tasks and parallel processing to build user workload model. The mobile edge computing(MEC) environment includes cloud environment server and base station processing unit. A two-level processor based on deep Q-learning is used to automatically generate the best long-term decision. In order to evaluate the effectiveness of the model, we use the sequential allocation method as the baseline, and compare the running time, with energy consumption and failure rate as the measurement indicators. Based on the test, the average energy consumption of our system is increased and the failure rate is reduced about 40% compared with the baseline.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Detection Based on Convolutional Network with Deep Instance Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this project, computer image enhancement processing, learning and analysis were carried out on a large number of brain multimodal medical images (MRI) from patients and a deep convolutional neural network was established to generalize the mask mapping function paradigm of learning images and diseased areas, so as to achieve accurate classification of high-grade glioma (HGG) and low-grade glioma (LGG); the semantic segmentation whole tumor area (WT) was carried out.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-dimensional Intelligent Perception in the Construction of Intelligent Pumped Storage Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the past, massive video, audio and gas data of pumped storage power plants could not be used for data analysis. It’s an impossible task to find the abnormality in time by manual monitoring. As a result, these systems are only for post analysis or review confirmation. The construction experience of intelligent pumped storage power plant is summarized in this paper. It is pointed out that the data island of industrial television system, noise monitoring system and gas online monitoring system should be broken. And data is collected and analyzed in a unified way, and machine vision, machine hearing and machine smell are acquired in real time. The view range, time scale and sensory dimension of patrol inspection have been got in the way of full range and full time coverage. In this paper, the construction experience of intelligent power plant since 2018 is summarized in terms of system structure, hardware configuration, technical route and engineering practice. The proposed technology management method has less transformation cost, lower operation and maintenance cost and wider function application.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Technology in the Automated Process of Online Reimbursement System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the drawbacks of using paper-based methods for corporate financial reimbursement, the article designs and implements an online reimbursement system based on artificial intelligence technology. The system adopts EOS, the most advanced middleware product in China, and strictly follows the MVC design concept of the J2EE framework to realize the business automation process of the financial reimbursement system. The realization of this system improves the efficiency of financial reimbursement, improves the management efficiency and ability of the enterprise, and truly achieves data sharing and integration.

articleTitle: Intelligent key management system based on face recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This subject intends to develop an intelligent key management system which can identify the identity of the visitor by facial recognition technology. This system has the functions of identity verification and access information recording. When the user lends or returns the key, the computer will verify the identity of the visitor and record the visitor’s face image and visiting time. The development of an intelligent key management system involves face recognition technology and image processing technology. The system has the functions of identity verification and access information recording. This system makes key management safer and more convenient, which is of great significance in the field of intelligent security.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Behavior Evaluation of Campus Security Vehicles Based on Improved AHP
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The development of intelligent vehicles is inseparable from its pre-designated evaluation system. Aiming at the campus environment, an evaluation model based on analytic hierarchy process was proposed. According to the actual situation of the campus, ten influencing factors such as information collection and identification, route planning, and safe operation are selected as indicators of the evaluation system. The improved analytic hierarchy process and the three-scale method are used to determine the evaluation index weights of the intelligent vehicle behavior at all levels, which greatly reduces the influence of subjective factors on the evaluation results, ensure the reliability and objectivity of the experimental results. The weight of each indicator of the intelligent behavior of the two vehicles can be clearly expressed by the experimental results, which is convenient for the intuitive comparison or ranking of the results. In addition, the evaluation results of the evaluation system are consistent with the actual situation, verifying that the improved analytic hierarchy process has guiding and reference significance in the field of intelligent vehicles intelligent behavior evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the Introduction of Multimedia Database in Computer Aided English Courseware Using Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: How to use information technology to introduce Chinese culture into English classrooms, eliminate Chinese cultural aphasia, and make up for the cultural shortcomings of students in international exchanges, is an urgent problem faced by higher vocational English teaching. By expounding the phenomenon of Chinese culture aphasia and analyzing the reasons, with the help of information technology, it explores the implementation path of introducing Chinese culture into higher vocational English teaching from three aspects: curriculum reform, teaching practice, and education evaluation. At the same time, we designed a new design method and implementation result of using multimedia database technology to realize computer-assisted teaching system. The system has enhanced query and interactive performance, good scalability, is conducive to teaching students in accordance with their aptitude, and is easy to popularize and use on the Internet. Teaching practice shows that the English learning atmosphere formed by the integration of rich Chinese cultural elements with the help of information technology is conducive to cultivating students’ cross-cultural communication skills, enhancing cultural literacy, and strengthening cultural self-confidence.

articleTitle: Determination and Application of Sample Size Using Computer Mathematical Statistics and Standard Deviation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The determination of sample size is an important part of the sample survey. This paper determines the sample size mainly considering the influence of factors such as the population size, absolute error limit, confidence level and population variance. At the same time, this paper also considers the method of obtaining the value of the population variance. At last, we give a real example to show the method. The example is about the analysis of the drip irrigation belt about the sample size.

articleTitle: Research on Multimedia Social Computer Intelligent Interaction System Based on Virtual Reality VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: From the perspective of multimedia development, integration and differentiation are two aspects of things that promote and promote each other. Promote the continuous advancement of the media and the media through the joint effect of these two aspects. Based on this research background, the thesis first defines a multimedia interactive system. Then based on the virtual reality VR, we introduced the design scheme of the integrated media interactive system based on the social media platform from the perspective of function and safety in detail. Through system detection, the spread of social network worms based on virtual reality VR technology in heterogeneous social networks was discovered, which revealed the influence of network topology and the degree of social network hybridization on the spread of worms, and provided important support for research on social network worms.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent assessment model and potential impacts of blockchain technology on grocery store by mathematical statistics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of blockchain technology on the supermarket (retal industry) in NZ from a technological and functional perspective. This research employs secondary research methods including desktop research, literature review and case studies. Blockchain technology affects the business process of supermarkets mainly by securing payments and provides an end-to-end supply chain that improves food security. However, this process is hampered bu a number of challenges including difficulty in adapting sound logistics, lack of adequate skills and resistance to change by employees. This can be addressed by imparting education/training and raising the awareness about the benefits of blockchain.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligence Information Technology Intelligent Community Interactive System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the increasing development of social information technology, community-based smart homes, as a new type of lifestyle, are changing people’s lives step by step. However, the services provided by the community are not yet complete, and the management is relatively mechanized. Therefore, improving work efficiency, enriching and improving community services is an issue that has received more and more attention. The article designs the intelligent community interactive system, which fully reveals the system function design, interactive system function design, resource management-related system function design, personal information management system function design, and the influence of system functions on users’ willingness to use. This system gradually establishes a multimedia integrated information interaction center that communicates the residents and residents within the community, the residents and the community management service center, and the residents and the external society.

articleTitle: Analysis of Engineering Project Computer Assisted Quality Control and Automatic Safety Monitoring System by Remote Signal Transmission Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the development of China’s market economy, the engineering construction industry plays an important role. The quality control and safety management of engineering and the correct application of relevant laws and regulations are issues of general concern to the society. In the management of construction site, adopting scientific, efficient and legal management mode can not only ensure the quality of construction, but also reduce the occurrence of safety accidents, and improve the efficiency of construction, which is the right choice with one stroke.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of maglev vibration isolation for underwater unmanned vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the low frequency vibration isolation effect of underwater unmanned vehicle, a kind of vibration isolator with high static and low dynamic stiffness (HSLDS) is designed. The isolator adopts Halbach permanent magnet structure, with large suspension force and low axial stiffness. This paper introduces the structure of the vibration isolator and establishes the finite element model of the magnetic suspension vibration isolator. The effects of the stator permanent magnet height, air gap width and other structural parameters on the negative stiffness characteristics were analyzed. With these parameters as constraints, the design of the isolator was carried out with the goal of large static axial force and small axial dynamic stiffness in the working area. Finally, an experimental prototype is developed to verify the performance of vibration isolation. The experimental result shows that the natural frequency of the isolator is 0.7 Hz, and the isolator has good performance.

articleTitle: Construction of Application Scenario for 5G Transmission Control Protocol in Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to meet multiple application scenarios under 5G networks, different types of transmission control protocols and network access conversion protocols. The protocols need to be designed to adapt to different data transmission requirements, and break through the limitations of edge network conditions. We focused on 5G network construction, explores the transmission control protocol and access conversion protocol from the perspective of application scenarios. We can lead in elaborating the potential application scenarios of 5G networks by analyzing the popular application scenarios of recent edge network research.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Face Mapping Method Based on Expression Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a virtual face mapping method based on facial expression classification. Accord to that face data collected by the camera, CNN is adopt to classify the collected faces, and the classification result is expressed in the form of probability, that is, the expression classification ratio obtain by CNN network. At the same time, 3D_max is used to reconstruct the 3D model of facial expression, and the offset matrix is weighted and summed to output the virtual face model according to the classification scale, thus constructing a face mapping model based on facial expression classification. Experimental results show that the virtual face has a strong sense of reality.

articleTitle: Research on computer assisted smart pension using structural equation model and diamond model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous increase of the elderly population in China, the degree of aging is deepening. Based on the theoretical framework of diamond model, this paper analyzes the current situation of smart pension industry, taking the four basic factors as the breakthrough point. Then, through the literature analysis, combined with the research purpose, we summarized and sorted out the Likert five scale corresponding to the research variables and formed the final questionnaire for distribution and collection, and tested the reliability and validity of the data. Next, this paper uses the structural equation model to make an empirical analysis of the smart pension industry, and gradually modifies the model. Finally, we put forward suggestions on the intelligent pension industry from the top-level design, talent training, and the development mode of the intelligent pension industry, so as to promote the better development of the intelligent pension industry.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Simulation System of UAV-Borne Missile
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: UAV-borne missile system is expensive and the cost of live-fire drill is high. Replacing real training with virtual training system can greatly improve the training efficiency and the combat effectiveness. By extension, the authenticity of the virtual training depends on the visual simulation system. This article choose a certain type of UAV-borne missile as research target, based on the study of the 3D modeling technology, model loading technology, scene building technology and so on, develop a visual simulation system based on the LabVIEW for a certain type of UAV-borne missile. The system has high fidelity and lays a good foundation for the research of virtual training operating system.

articleTitle: Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology Applied in New Retail System through Network Platform and Mobile Internet Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Under the epidemic situation, the terminal distribution of emergency life support materials faces many problems. Physical stores are temporarily closed to individuals, it is difficult for consumers to go out shopping, the supply and demand of life support materials are not connected, circulation channels are blocked, express personnel are in short supply, the third-party emergency logistics system is lagging, and express delivery There are many restrictions on pick-ups and high-level calls for contactless delivery. In response to these issues, the article summarizes and analyzes “community group buying + centralized pickup mode”, “store sharing + gas station non-contact self-pickup mode”, “O2O platform group + New types of terminal logistics distribution modes for emergency life support materials such as “shared delivery personnel distribution mode”, “front warehouse + non-contact intelligent machine distribution mode”. Based on J2EE and cloud computing technology, this article proposes a new retail system architecture for community group buying of fresh agricultural products. In the design of the overall, software, business and data of the smart community, three aspects of the construction of the new retail system for community group buying of fresh agricultural products are aimed at. A solution was proposed for each problem. The successful application of this architecture design in the case of a new retail system for group buying of fresh agricultural products in the community demonstrates its effectiveness.

Author Keywords: community group buying system for fresh agricultural products

articleTitle: Research and Computer Aided Design of Information System for Public Sector Using Database System and Digitization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Improving the efficiency of human resource management and enhancing organizational competitiveness is one of the effective ways to improve efficiency in public administration. An important way to improve human resource management is information-based human resource management. Informatized HRM is a new comprehensive and open HRM model that uses advanced electronic information technology as a means and software systems as a platform to achieve low cost, high efficiency, and joint participation of all employees in the management process to realize the strategic position of human resources. In this paper, we study the basis of HR-related theories and develop and design an HR informational management system based on B/S architecture, MVC model, which improves the efficiency of HR integration and improves the operational efficiency of public administration.

articleTitle: The Influence of Air Applying/Exhausting Mode on Air Velocity Distribution Using Fluent Software and Computational Fluid Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Air velocity distribution and air update capability have been studied using Fluent software. The results show that the air velocity near the bed is 0.11 m/s when the upper outlet and upper return air applying mode and 2.0 m/s air supplying velocity are adopted, which meets indoor comfort requirements. The return velocity is 2.6 m/s, which is suitable for pollutant emission. When the upper outlet and lower return (the return windows are distributed on both sides of the bed) is adopted, the airflow velocity near the bed is 2.0 m/s, and with the increase of the distance from the bed, the speed near the return tuyere can also reach 2.6 m/s, meets the requirements of indoor comfort and pollutant emission. When the upper outlet is opposite to the lower return(they are set on the against walls), the low speed range $(0.04 \sim 0.07\mathrm{m} /\mathrm{s})$ appears near the ward. The average air age near the patient is longer and the air quality is poor, which is not conducive to the recovery of patient.

articleTitle: The Research on High Precision Digital Oscilloscope High Performance Trigging System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on mechanism of the high-performance trigger of the high-precision digital oscilloscope, the trigger classification and realization of the trigger control system. High speed data stream is obtained after high-precision ADC sampling at the front end, which is transmitted to the FPGA asynchronous FIFO to receive at a reduced speed, and the data is divided into two signals, one is sent to the trigger control system as the source signal, and the other is sent to the synchronous FIFO as the data storage. The trigger control system generates an enable signal according to the original signal and the set trigger mode, and the enable signal controls the storage of data. The function of the trigger control system is mainly to accurately locate the trigger point of the stored data and store the data in an orderly manner according to the trigger point.

articleTitle: Computer assisted design and development of map building tracked robot based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: the raspberry pie with ROS environment is used as the upper computer, and the workstation between the lower computer and the lidar is established. Through the subscriber and publisher of the node, the Arduino controller of the lower computer is communicated in real time. Using the working machine and SSH to realize the remote control of the robot installed with Rplidar laser radar, the design and development of indoor scene map building crawler robot is realized.

articleTitle: Computer Numerical Simulation of Bridge Vibration Abatement under Uninterrupted Traffic Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The rapid development of the national economy has led to the rapid growth of the transportation industry, which has increased the intensity of bridge maintenance and repair, it is necessary to carry out the bridge maintenance and maintenance by optimizing the arrangement of the dampers to reduce the vibration. In this paper, the Maxwell damping model is introduced to apply the passive viscous reaction to the bridge, and the time-history analysis method is used to simulate and calculate the influence of the different arrangement angle of the viscous dampers on the energy dissipation and vibration reduction effect of the bridge under the transient vehicle load at a certain driving speed. The results show that the z-axis displacement of the bridge changes in a conic curve with the increase of the Damper Angle, and the damping effect is the best when the damper is 45°. The optimal design is applied to the vibration reduction of maintenance under uninterrupted traffic condition. The maximum amplitude in the maintenance area can be reduced by 41%.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model on regional coordinated development through Mobile Internet and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet, especially the mobile Internet, China’s regional economy has entered a new stage of development. In order to promote the economic development in the new era, it is necessary to understand the development trend, combine with the current regional, temporal and spatial characteristics, analyze the overall pattern, optimize the coordinated development in the region with the new normal of regional economy, and take the policy to promote the development as the core, and innovate and optimize The regional management mode should be changed.

articleTitle: Computer Assisted Control and Experimental Study on Stiffness of Square Rubber Spring by Accurate Measurement and Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of people’s requirements for travel comfort, rubber springs have been widely used in rail vehicles and other transportation fields. As a high elastic body with good damping effect, the rubber spring is often used in complex conditions. Therefore, this paper makes theoretical analysis and experimental research on the vertical and transverse stiffness of the rubber spring, and lists the experimental data and relevant results, so as to provide basis for the application research of rubber spring and guarantee the development of rail transit.

articleTitle: Computer Big Data Sentiment Intelligent Analysis Using Maximum Likelihood and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This With the field of machine learning continues flourishes, the rising demand of understanding human emotions brings attention of solving the issue of SA using deep learning. In this study, we want to utilize CNN techniques to evaluate a real dataset containing movie reviews with annotations either positive or negative. We will clean the data by removing html tags, removing non-alphabetical word, and removing stop words. Then we will first introduce one classification method based on statistical analysis based on maximum likelihood and discuss the usage of different smoothing methods. We will be able to construct a bag-of words model based on the statistical analysis. Lastly, we will convert the vector into multi-dimensional matrix and build a CNN model to categorize whether a movie review is positive or negative. As a result, we show that both approaches are effective proved by cross validation and discuss the differences between two methods and some common drawbacks.

articleTitle: Surface Water Change Characteristics of Qinghai Lake from 2000-2020 Based on the Google Earth Engine Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As an important water resource within the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau region, Qinghai Lake plays an important role in climate regulation. In recent years, Qinghai Lake is rapidly expanding by climate factors and other influences, which also affects climate change and restricts the sustainable development of the region. In this paper, based on Google Earth Engine platform, Landsat images are used to compare six lake water index methods, and finally the NDWI method is selected to extract the area of Qinghai Lake for the last 20 years from 2000 to 2020. Finally, the influence of precipitation, humidity, temperature and other climatic factors on the changes of Qinghai Lake is explored. The results indicated that (1) in general, Qinghai Lake showed an overall upward trend in the last 20 years, with an area expansion of about 306.85 km2 and an average expansion rate of 15.34 km2/y. (2) Qinghai Lake in the period 2000-2020 roughly (3) Qinghai Lake experienced four stages during 2000-2020: fluctuation stage, expansion stage, stable stage and rapid expansion stage. (4) Precipitation and evaporation are the main reasons for the change of the lake area of Qinghai Lake.

articleTitle: Research on Denoising Method of Optical Fiber Sensing Vibration Signal Based on Enhanced Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: There are many kinds of noises in optical fiber sensing signals. Environmental natural noise and attenuation noise are the two most widely existing noises. They directly affect the quality of optical fiber sensing vibration signal. This paper mainly deals with the attenuation noise in the vibration signal of optical fiber sensing. Firstly, a neural network with trapezoidal convolution kernel structure is constructed to enhance the amplitude of optical fiber sensing vibration signal. The network consists of up-down sampling network. The down-sampling network obtains the dimensional features by learning a specific mapping relationship. The up-sampling network obtains the enhanced signal directly from the features through the deconvolution network. Secondly, the parameters of the network are set and the network is trained. Finally, qualitative and quantitative experiments are used to evaluate the advantages of the proposed algorithm. The results show that the proposed algorithm has better amplitude enhancement effect than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis and Computer Intelligent Prediction Model of College Entrance Examination Number through ARIMA and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, we review the changes of the Chinese college entrance examination system, and introduce the current situation of the college entrance examination. The ARIMA model in time series analysis is used to predict the number of people participating in the college entrance examination in the future, so as to grasping the future development direction of China’s college entrance examination.

Author Keywords: the college entrance examination number in China

articleTitle: Computer Mathematical Statistics and Empirical Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Savings by Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The continuous rise of household savings has many disadvantages, which to some extent also restricts the development of the economy. The article uses the data released by the National Bureau of Statistics from 1992 to 2015 to construct an econometric model to conduct an empirical study on the various factors that affect household savings balance. The results display that household savings are mainly determined by income level, price index and population structure.

articleTitle: Study of Computer Assisted Design of Smart Software Development of Reliability Evaluation for Auxiliary Equipment of Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on reliability of auxiliary equipment, the paper briefly proposed a correct calculating method of reliability evaluation. A calculation software of reliability evaluation is developed. It can normalize and unify computation, solve some problems such as the organic combination of manual intervention and computer calculation and the cyclic iteration of some parameters. The study can help to improve speed and accuracy of computation and improve the efficiency of the economy and cost savings. It enhance the competitiveness of power generators, and has a important utility value

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Communication Network Planning Method Based on MCTS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Network planning is a crucial process in the construction of emergency communication network. To make emergency communication network planning scientifically and effectively, with the combine of Mont Carlo tree search algorithm and deep learning, the paper proposes an intelligence planning method based on MCTS. The simulation results show that the intelligence network planning method based on MCTS can generate the network plans which with high rationality and efficiently.

articleTitle: Estimation Model of Environmental Leakage of Plastic Waste along the Yangtze River Based on Remote Sensing Data and UAV Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to overcome the large amount of pollution caused by plastic waste leakage along the Yangtze River, a novel estimation model of environmental leakage of plastic waste along the Yangtze River based on remote sensing data and UAV data is proposed in this paper. The estimation model fully combines remote sensing technology and UAV technology to estimate and predict according to scientific data information. Based on this, this paper also uses the methods of field investigation, observation and literature research to analyze the pollution caused by plastic waste along the Yangtze River from multiple dimensions, and further improve the estimation model combined with foreign scientific experience. The results show that the estimation model designed in this paper can effectively estimate the specific degree of environmental leakage of plastic waste along the Yangtze River, which provides some reference value for relevant work.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology and 3D Simulation Design System in Landscape Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article develops a new 3D simulation design system for urban planning based on computer big data technology. Build a MongoDB database to safely store the measured data of urban planning and the data generated during the design process. The 3D design module builds a 3D model of the urban scene based on OpenGL modules, and uses digital elevation models and digital orthophotos to solve urban planning problems with large slope terrain. The computer big data technology module calculates the vertex normal, vertex coordinates, and texture coordinates of the urban landscape to present virtual planning effects, and performs model traversal rendering according to code instructions, and interactively controls the rotation and translation of the camera through interactive control instructions to realize interactive roaming of urban planning dynamic landscape simulation. According to the results of the simulation experiment, the system can plan a reasonable number of landscapes according to the slope of the terrain, and the accuracy of processing 3D point cloud data is as high as 99%. It is a landscape planning system with high satisfaction.

articleTitle: A study on the application of computer video analysis recording technology and image processing in assisted training system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Video analysis and feedback system can cater to the needs of recording and analysis of tennis sports. Today’s tennis sports training system based on computer video analysis recording technology is more comprehensive in function. Based on this research background the article designs a tennis sports training video analysis as well as feedback system. The system has more complete video acquisition and storage, movement analysis and training prediction. The system uses tennis serve technique prediction as a test item, and the arm movement trajectory of the player can be obtained after color marking the arm joint points of the player’s serve, and verifies that the serve point predicted by the system is the best point to hit the ball.

articleTitle: A Computer Dynamic Index Forecast Model Based on Indicator of Long Short-Term Memory and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposed a method for stock prediction. In terms of stock features, we considered the features of social macroeconomic indicators which can influence stock prices. First, we crawled social macroeconomic indicators online. We proposed a method (SMILSTM, social macroeconomic indicator of Long Short-Term Memory) to predict stock prices which considers social macroeconomic indicators feature. Compared to LSTM regression with price feature, we found our proposed method had a great improvement on stock prediction accuracy in experiments.

articleTitle: Synchronization of asynchronous signals of the in-wheel permanent magnet motors control system for hydrogen fuel cell vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A controller with high performance that can be used for in-wheel permanent magnet motors of hydrogen fuel cell vehicle is designed in this paper. The controller contains one FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) chip and two DSP (Digital Signal Processing) chips.
