Two DSP chips can provide power for four independent in-wheel motors of one hydrogen fuel cell vehicle at the same time. The large amounts of sensor data are processed by the FPGA. An edge detection synchronizer is designed to realize real time communicate between DSP and FPGA via XINTF module.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Large Caliber Naval Gun Launching System Based on New Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Through the application of a series of new technologies such as large-angle fixed-angle filling technology, optical energy-focusing ignition technology, and combustible cartridges, the reliability of large-caliber naval guns has been greatly improved compared with the previous traditional solutions. Then, based on the failure mode of the launch system, the ceasefire fault tree of the launch system is constructed, and on this basis, the reliability allocated research based on the bottom event is carried out. According to the allocated results, reliability improvement factors and strategies are given, which also have certain guiding significance for the reliability evaluation of the launch system. The results show that the damage of the window of the optical energy-concentrating ignition device, the moisture absorption of the combustible cartridge and the failure of the bomb chain subjected to large loads and large impacts are the weak links of the new technology. In the design process, the reasons for the failure should be analyzed and a smaller reliability index should be assigned to such a bottom event due to technical difficulty, cost-effectiveness ratio and high task reliability.

articleTitle: Key technology research of computer assisted control circular pipe jacking machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Circular tunnel lining structure features the benefits of uniform force, simple manufacturing, easy control of thrust axis and convenient construction, etc. The tunnel construction of circular pipe jacking machine has the advantages of no road excavation, no traffic closure, no relocation of pipelines, reduction of noise and dust, etc. This paper briefly introduces the calculation methods of key dimensions such as machine length, machine OD and pipe section thickness in the overall structure design, and then discusses the five key technologies of pipe jacking machine design, the earth pressure balance and slurry balance pipe jacking developed by these key technologies have completed the construction of Zhengzhou, Nanchang, Nanning and other tunnels, which effectively improved the speed and quality of tunnel construction.

articleTitle: Comparison Analysis of High-Resolution Remote Sensing Image Fusion Based on the Multiresolution Pyramid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: High resolution remote sensing image fusion can overcome the shortage of spectral and spatial information of panchromatic and multispectral images, and obtain the fusion images with high spatial-spectral resolution. In this paper, Laplacian, contrast, gradient and morphological pyramid algorithms are used to verify the fusion of WorldView-II panchromatic and multispectral images. The fusion effects of the four algorithms are compared and analyzed from the combination of qualitative and quantitative evaluation methods. The experimental results show that the contrast pyramid algorithm effectively improves the spectral fidelity of high resolution remote sensing image fusion while maintaining the spatial information; There is little difference between gradient and Laplacian pyramid algorithm; morphological pyramid algorithm is the worst.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the ROB Algorithm Simulator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: ROB (Reorder Buffer) Algorithm is an important and efficient algorithm to solve problems about data hazards and control hazards in the CPU pipeline. Learning the ROB Algorithm can help us understand how the CPU pipeline works. However, the algorithm is too obscure and complex to study, and the traditional teaching and experiment are also too difficult to carry out. Therefore, developing a ROB Algorithm Simulator to show the working process of the ROB Algorithm can give great help to the teaching. This paper mainly discusses the design and implementation of the ROB Algorithm Simulator based on the MVVM pattern. This paper firstly introduces the main content of the ROB Algorithm, then introduces the MVVM pattern, the architecture of the simulator, and the design of the ROB simulation algorithm. Later this paper shows the implementation and the usage of the simulator, and finally gives the test of the simulator.

articleTitle: Comparison of Remote Sensing Image Fusion Rules Based on the Laplacian Pyramid Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to select the fusion rules to improve the quality of remote sensing image fusion and data utilization, WorldView-II images are fused using 16 fusion rules. Better fusion rules can be identified using qualitative and quantitative evaluation methods in the spectral, spatial and comprehensive index. The experimental results show that low frequency using multispectral image has a good effect, can better maintain the spectral fidelity of fusion images. When using high frequency consistency check, the evaluation index is the highest, and the fusion image can highlight the edge and texture information of the image, easy for human eye observation. High frequency using the regional mean gradient, the fusion effect is slightly poor and the spectral fidelity is slightly lower. When using high frequency absolute value maximization, the fusion effect is general, and there is a certain confusion phenomenon. When using high frequency regional energy, the fusion effect is poor and may introduce too much spatial information.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation analysis and characteristic research of truck crane
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper takes truck crane as the research object. Based on Solidworks and Adams software, the dynamic modeling and motion characteristics of lifting robots are analyzed. The characteristic curve of the dynamic response is derived. According to the parameters, SolidWorks software is used to build a three-dimensional model of the vehicle lifting robot, combining with the performance index and parameters of the automobile crane system, the mathematical dynamics model of the system is established. Using PID control strategies to optimize and improving their motion and characteristics.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Shared Vehicles Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of the Internet era, a series of “sharing” industries and supporting products have emerged, sharing umbrellas, sharing power banks, and even sharing cars have also appeared in people’s vision. In order to solve the current allocation and scheduling problem in the shared car industry, we propose to use an improved ant colony algorithm for optimal scheduling. The experimental results show that according to the scheduling distance of shared vehicles, the improved ant colony algorithm is used to optimize the scheduling, and the optimal path for scheduling shared vehicles is obtained, that is, the shortest distance is 183, 898.64m, and the corresponding regional scheduling sequence is: Region 2$\rightarrow$ Region 5$\rightarrow$ Region 4$\rightarrow$Region 1$\rightarrow$ Region 6$\rightarrow$ Region 3. Finally, we use the shared car use data in Beijing to verify the scalability and applicability of the model, and the model has good applicability.

Author Keywords: Improved Ant Colony Algorithm Spatiotemporal Analysis

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Distributed Fault-Tolerant Computer Middleware of Deterministic Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, the distributed fault-tolerant computer middleware of deterministic communication is designed, under the distributed system architecture; key technologies such as distributed node synchronization/communication technology, distributed system membership management, and membership consistency guarantee are mainly discussed. First, the distributed fault-tolerant computer architecture and related technologies of deterministic communication are introduced, then the software design is explained, and the design and implementation of middleware software are mainly discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Application Prospects of Computer Information Network Information Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Computer networks cover almost all areas of daily life. At the same time, computer network information security issues have become increasingly prominent. At present, China is paying more and more attention to and strengthening the management of computer network information security. In order to ensure the information security of computer networks, it is necessary to adopt effective protection strategies to reduce and eliminate various hidden dangers of network information security. The paper puts forward the application of grey theory to the evaluation of the effect of cyber-attacks, and studies the grey evaluation model and evaluation algorithm of the effect of cyber-attacks. The results show that this method can not only evaluate the attack effect of a single attack method, but also rank the effects of different attack methods.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Challenge in Personalization under Industrial Internet and Intelligent Manufacturing Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nowadays increasing manufactures are paying more and more attention to customer satisfaction. But consumers do not satisfy only the simple selection of the assembly combination which are provided by the manufacturers. At the same time products combining low price with extensive adaption and variation are essential, but not crucial. Actually, getting the customers involved in co-creation and co-design of products from the start will be at the corporations’ foundation. With the market trend of personalization and servitization, many enterprises take socialization and mass collaboration as new opportunities for their future growth. At the same time, social manufacturing as an emerging manufacturing mode is attracting more and more attention of researchers and enterprises. As a result, the personalization based on the individual explicit needs manufacturing mode is on the agenda in many small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). This paper will discuss the key dimensions of personalization under emerging social manufacturing paradigm and the influence on “individual pinpoint needs” SMEs.

articleTitle: Optimization and solution of the temperature curve of the furnace
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the production process of electronic products such as the process integrated circuit board, some firmware need to be welded to the circuit board through the rewelding furnace heating, where the temperature setting of each temperature area and the control of the overpassing furnace speed play a crucial role in the quality of the product. For the convenience of industrial production, this article mainly applies the physical knowledge of Newton’s cooling law and two-dimensional non-steady heat transfer to study the optimal furnace temperature curve and conveyor belt through the furnace speed, and participates in the programming calculation and curve simulation with the help of matlab.

articleTitle: Conversational Recommender System Based on GRU-attention Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the conversational recommender system (CRS) based on natural language processing technology has gained widespread attention, aiming to learn and model user preferences through interactive dialogue. Although existing research has improved the accuracy of the dialogue recommendation system to a certain extent, there are still some shortcomings that make it easy to generate more general and popular responses. This paper proposes a deep learning framework with GRU and attention mechanism on the basis of knowledge graph, namely KGGA. Through the serialized modeling of conversation content and effectively capture the user’s interest to make correct recommendations. Experiments conducted on widely baselines show that the proposed framework is superior to the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Service Driver Based Application Execution and Development Method in Multi-cloud Context
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To reduce the cost of cloud tenants and avoid the phenomenon of vendor lock-in, multi-cloud technique is proposed and competent for this goal. However, it leads to another difficultly on supporting application development and runtime update process in the multi-cloud context. The key points for this problem are: (i) implementing application runtime switch among cloud services for varied service requirements and status; (ii) supporting runtime agile and low-cost update, and redevelopment for emerging new cloud services. To overcome this problem and advance multi-cloud applications execution, we present a support technique based on service driver concept. Service driver can help applications shield the heterogeneity and switch among cloud services. To support the implementation of service driver, we have finished the following three areas: (i) proposing a multi-cloud application service access model which is implemented through multi-agent system technique; (ii) presenting a multi-cloud application runtime service update and invocation process; (iii) introducing a multi-cloud application development framework. Furthermore, to help and direct developers to design and implement multi-cloud application, we describe a multi-cloud application (re)development method. This method includes multi-cloud application development process and runtime multi-cloud application agile redevelopment process. Finally, we interpret the multi-cloud application development support techniques and methods via case study.

articleTitle: Chinese named entity recognition method based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The word embedding of traditional named entity recognition (NER) methods can’t represent the polysemy of a word, can’t fully consider contextual information, and the local features in the extraction process are easy to be ignored. To solve this problem, a named entity recognition method based on Bert is proposed, and the BERT-BiLSTM-IDCNN-CRF model is built. Bert is used for pre-training, and then the trained word vectors are input into bidirectional long-term and short-term memory network (BiLSTM) and iterative dilation convolution network (IDCNN) to extract features. Then the output features of the two neural networks are combined, and finally the prediction results are corrected by conditional random field (CRF). The experimental results show that the F1 value of the model on the CLUENER data set reaches 81.18%, which is 4.79% higher than the F1 value of the BiLSTM-CRF bench mark model, which verifies the effectiveness of the method in the NER task.

articleTitle: Analysis and Calculating of Comprehensive Urban Vitality Index by Multi-Source Temporal-Spatial Big Data and EW-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Urban vitality analysis is an important means to measure the attractiveness and cohesion of urban development, which is of great significance to urban operation situation awareness, fine governance and planning design. Taking China Singapore Tianjin Eco-city as the research area, based on multisource temporal-spatial data from January 2020 to February 2021 provided by the smart city data aggregation platform, such as the data of urban transportation, catering waste recycling volume, books borrowed and returned, this paper analyzed the urban vitality index from five aspects of society, transportation, commerce, culture-education and tourism. After spatializing data into geographic grids, method EW-TOPSIS (Entropy Weighted Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution) has been utilized to calculate the comprehensive vitality index. The results showed that: from temporal perspective, the vitality of each index was significantly different due to the impact of Corona Virus Disease 2019(COVID-I9) and seasons; the comprehensive vitality decreased sharply to the lowest at the beginning of the COVID-19 while it increased rapidly and then stabilized after the weakening of the prevention and control policies; the comprehensive vitality value of Eco-city reached the peak of the whole year during the National Day Golden Week affected by tourism vitality. From spatial perspective, the distribution of Eco-city vitality level is unbalanced, showing a trend of outward diffusion centered on the urban starting area and the main tourist attractions.

Author Keywords: Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Load Forecasting via Recurrent Neural Network with Similar Day Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the increase of the penetration rate of renewable energy generation, the smart grid system needs to be more intelligent, flexible and interactive. Load forecasting, especially the short-term load forecasting for power users, is playing an important role in the future grid planning and operation. Aiming at dealing the strong randomness and low prediction accuracy of short-term load forecasting, we proposed a short-term load forecasting model for smart grid via recurrent neural network with similar day selection. Firstly, the fuzzy clustering method was used to preprocess the sample data to generate the similar day set, and then an improved grey correlation analysis method was used to select the similar days from this set. The recurrent neural network was trained after the similar day selection. Our model can avoid the recurrent neural network falling into the local optimum and leading to a low prediction accuracy. Finally, we implemented our model in a real scenario with historical data of a certain area in Guangdong Province, the experimental results show that the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy and stability, and enjoy a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Construction and Adaptability Analysis of User’s Preference Model Based on Check-in Data in LBSN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the widespread use of mobile phones, users can share their location anytime, anywhere, as a form of check-in data. These data reflect user preferences. Furthermore, the preference rules for different users vary. How to discover a user’s preference from their related information and how to validate whether a preference model is suited to a user is important for providing a suitable service to the user. This study provides three main contributions. First, multiple preference models from different views for each user are constructed. Second, an algorithm is proposed to validate whether a preference model is applicable to the user by calculating the stability value of the user’s long-term check-in data for each model. Third, three data sets from multiple sources are used to verify the validity of the method, the results of which show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach of Unknown Network Attack Detection Based on Zero-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Along with the computer network and software systems tend to be complex, using new technology, the method such as holes or social engineering skills on the implementation of the unknown network attack methods emerge in endlessly. Due to lack of corresponding labels in such attacks when detecting actually, traditional learning methods which need large amounts of labelled data will often appear low accuracy, besides, existing approaches of zero-shot learning suffer from domain shift problems. In our paper, we put forward a novel approach of unknown network attack detection on the basis of zero-shot learning. Under the multi-metric space, we align semantic embedding and visual embedding via designing a zero-shot learning model based on variational autoencoder, and transfer known class learning to the unknown class through the semantic feature vector. This approach not only alleviates the projection domain shift problem, but also improving the detection accuracy of unknown network attacks. Experiments show that our model has good practicability and feasibility on the NSL - KDD dataset, comparing with the other classifier models.

articleTitle: Intelligent Evaluation and Reflection Model Applied in Internet Smart Teaching Tools by Computer Remote Video Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To prevent and control the outbreak of coronavirus disease, in the spring of 2020 the Ministry of Education in China announced an initiative for universities to postpone the back-to-school season and start nationwide online teaching. This paper first summarizes the literature review of research on online teaching at home and abroad. Then it introduces the application of smart teaching tool Rain Classroom in College English course at Huazhong Agricultural University and the teaching design before, during, and after class. After comparative teaching experiments, empirical data suggest that students achieved notable progress in academic performance in classes using smart teaching tools. In the questionnaire survey, students show high level of adaptability and satisfaction to the teaching model and learning outcomes. Thus it can be concluded that smart teaching tools guaranteed the high quality of online teaching during the coronavirus pandemic. At last, the author proposes suggestions on the R& D of smart teaching tools and faculty teaching development. It is hoped that this paper can provide reference for future research on online teaching.

articleTitle: Functional Comparison and Analysis of 14 Plant Identification APPs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To train learners’ autonomous learning of garden plants and guide them to use plant identification APP reasonably to learn plant knowledge, we adopted questionnaire survey method and actual measurement method to explore learners’ cognition and functional preferences for plant identification APP, as well as plant identification rate, plant expansion information, use comfort, and leisure social interaction. Research results: (1) 92.5% of learners support using plant identification APP as an auxiliary learning tool. (2) The weight ratio of the learners’ preference to the four functions of plant identification APP, plant identification rate, plant expansion information, use comfort, and leisure social interaction, is 1.87:1.75:1.67:1. (3) The identification of most plant identification APPs for double organs or triple organs is generally higher than that of single organ. (4) Comprehensive analysis shows that Baidushitu, Huabanlv, Xingse, Shiwubao, Huabangzhu, Huacaojun, and Zhiwushibie are excellent APPs that can be popularized in garden plant learning. (5) The comparative analysis showed that those who learn plants for the first time could give priority to Xingse. Learners with a certain plant foundation should choose Huabanlv, Shiwubao, Huabangzhu. For situations requiring rapid identification of plants, Huabanlv, Xingse and Huabangzhu should be selected. Plant landscape designers or landscape maintainers should choose Baidushitu, Shiwubao, Huabangzhu, Huacaojun and other APPs with high recognition rate and rich information on garden plant expand information.

articleTitle: Real-Time Image Detection of Traffic Light in Complex Intersection Traffic Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve traffic safety at the road intersections when vehicles passing by, a traffic light detection technology based on the traditional image processing method for complex intersection traffic environments is proposed. Firstly, a dataset of traffic images was collected, and distribution laws of the HSV pixel values were statistically analyzed to produce a set of segmentation thresholds under some specified probabilities. Secondly, distribution characteristics of the geometric shape parameters for traffic lights in real drive situations were resolved so as to made their numerical intervals certain. Then, with the help of a defined 9-dimensional pixel density feature, a support vector machine was trained to judge whether the image was a traffic light or not and recognize its type, by which way a large number of interference images were filtered out. Finally, another support vector machine trained by a defined 1764-dimensional feature of the extended image regions was used to verify the survived images to reduce the wrong detection rate. Experiment results showed that the detection algorithm worked with a 98.41% accuracy rate and 1.08% missed detection rate, meanwhile showed a strong adaptability and good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory Neural Intelligent Network Forecast Model Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of time series forecasting and enhance the interpretability of the structural feature parameters of the forecasting model, this paper improved Particle Swarm Optimization-Long Short-Term Memory Network model which has been used in ship motion attitude prediction, intelligent traffic flow prediction, stock prediction, etc. Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization-Long Short-Term Memory neural network model (APSO-LSTM model) is proposed. The prediction model changes the traditional PSO algorithm shortcoming which is easily falling into the local optimal. By constructing an adaptive PSO algorithm to search overall optimal to optimize the key parameters of the LSTM model, the accuracy of the prediction model is improved. Compared with the traditional LSTM model, the impact of human intervention is reduced. This article selects the US gold futures price information as the representative of the gold futures price level to verify the APSO-LSTM prediction model and compares the prediction results of the model with the traditional RNN model and LSTM model prediction results. The results show that the LSTM prediction model based on adaptive PSO improves the accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: New energy vehicle customer mining model and algorithm optimization through smart integrated learning model and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper combines the performance of new energy vehicle commercial indicators and the basic characteristics of users to establish an integrated learning model to tap potential users. First, preprocess the data, classify new energy vehicles and user characteristic variables, mainly divide them into continuous variables and discrete variables, and process them appropriately; then, use chi-square filtering. This statistic is used to filter out the characteristic variables whose chi-square value is as large as possible and the P value is less than 0.05 through chi-square values and p-values to obtain important factors that influence customers to purchase new energy vehicles; secondly, four base classifiers are selected: Logistic regression, random forest, Adaboost, SVM, Due to the imbalance of the sample, first perform upsampling to expand the sample, and then perform fitting to obtain its performance results. Finally, the customer mining model is established. The accuracy of the model is 0.9959, indicating that the integrated learning algorithm has shown its performance on the data set. Excellent performance; it also shows that the robustness of the model is better.

articleTitle: Micro-expression Recognition Based on Multi-Scale Attention Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the field of micro-expression recognition (MER), facial feature extraction is an important factor that affects the accuracy of MER. Most of the existing facial MER technologies use traditional feature extraction methods for classification. In view of the lack of effective fusion of global and local features in traditional feature learning methods, and the inability to learn the action information of key areas of the face, we propose a Multi-Scale Attention Fusion (MSAF) method. Specifically, we use attention gates to select the most informative image regions at different scales to generate category predictions. This can better obtain the image information of the detailed part of the datasets. Furthermore, we adopt a skip connection before fusion to ensure the effective transmission of image detail information. Convolutional Long Short-term Memory (ConvLSTM) is used to extract the fused temporal features to construct more advanced local and global temporal change fusion features. The experiments in the SMIC, CASME, and CASME-II datasets show that our method is effective, especially in the CASME dataset.

articleTitle: Review of a 3D lidar combined with single vision calibration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the multi-sensor information fusion technology, cameras and 3D lidars have been rapidly developed and widely used on the premise that their characteristics are highly complementary. In many applications based on cameras and 3D lidars, camera internal parameters as well as the joint calibration of camera and 3D lidar external parameters is an important foundation for later detection, tracking, and SLAM mapping technology. With the update and iteration of the algorithm, the accuracy, speed, and scope of calibration have been improved, but there still lack of the systematic and comprehensive review of camera and 3D lidar calibration. This article first introduces the performance comparison and application status of the two sensors; secondly, it introduces the calibration process, calibration target selection and calibration model establishment; then according to the classification, it introduces the principles and algorithms of camera internal parameter calibration and joint external parameter calibration; finally, it summarizes and gives the future development of camera and 3D lidar calibration.

articleTitle: Federated Learning for Recognizing Private Handwritten Numbers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a new technology in the field of machine learning, which trains an algorithm across multiple decentralized edge devices or servers holding data samples, without exchanging their data samples. Horizontal Federated Learning (HFL) is a FL method focusing on using the same feature space across all users, which is suitable for situations where users’ data feature dimensions overlap more. Because FL has the advantage of privacy protection in the field of manufacturing, we propose an HFL-based deep learning method named FedCNN, which realizes the digits handwritten recognition without violating the privacy or data sharing. Three different methods (local model, centralized model, and HFL-based FedCNN) are used on a public data set (MINIST) to compare the pros and cons of the solutions. The experimental results demonstrate that FedCNN scheme can simultaneously achieve practical privacy preservation and good model generalization performance with Homomorphic Encryption.

articleTitle: Researches and Application Practice on Intelligent Information Management System for Electric Vehicle Industry in China by Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of national economy, the Chinese auto industry has been developing rapidly, which meanwhile has caused tremendous pressure upon energy security, climate change and environmental protection. With a view to alleviate the energy and environment protection pressure, and further promote the development of energy saving and new energy auto industry, the competent governmental department in China has researched and introduced the CAFC and NEV Credit Management System, established a flexible credit trading mechanism, and meanwhile built a government management platform to coordinate the promotion of CAFC and NEV credit management work. Since the official implementation of the CAFC and NEV Credit Management System, good social and economic benefits have been achieved in guiding the improvement of the Chinese auto industry in the level of energy-saving technology and promotion of development of the new energy auto industry, which has had a positive influence on the formulation of energy-saving and emission-reduction measures abroad..

articleTitle: Research on conflict-free paths of multiple AGVs based on time-expanded graphs
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper studies Multi-AGVs (Automated Guided Vehicles) System to ensure path planning under the condition of conflict-free. Establish a topological structure map model. To solve the common conflict problem of Multi-AGVs systems, a method of time-expanded graph is proposed. The static graph is expanded into dynamic time graph. Several common conflict types are classified, and conflict detection models are established based on this method. The path search algorithm adopts an improved A* algorithm which combines tradition A* and Tabu-search algorithm to improve search efficiency. Simulation experiments under different working conditions prove that by comparing the time window method, with the increase of the map scale and the number of AGVs, the method proposed in this paper can have better performance on the four path indicators of the makespan(last handling time), the total handling time, the maximum handling distance, and the total handling distance, prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Evaluation Model of Chengdu-Chongqing Level Measurement through Big Data Technology and Mathematical Statistics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Market integration is an important part of the integrated development of Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration. The market integration of Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration has experienced an evolution process of market leading, government leading, government and market synergistic promotion. The relative price method is used to measure the market integration level of Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration which shows the regional market of Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration tends to be integrated in adjustment and fluctuation, but there still exists a serious problem of market segmentation. The three markets of capital factor, commodity and labor show a similar trend of change, but the level of integration is different and fluctuates greatly from time to time. Therefore, Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration market integration has a long way to go. The paper puts forward a proposal that we should deepen reforms and encrouge innovation so that the key markets can be held and fundamental support can be accessible.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Household Microgrid with Electric Vehicle Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As an important carrier of smart grid and distributed power supply, household microgrid can develop personalized power supply service according to the situation of users to play their important role. In order to solve the problem of high operating cost of household microgrid, this paper proposes an optimized dispatching method for household microgrid with electric vehicles in combination with demand response. And a demand response strategy for transferable loads and an orderly charge-discharge strategy for electric vehicles combined with time-of-use tariffs were formulated, and the corresponding demand response model is established, as well as the optimal scheduling model aiming at the lowest operating cost of household microgrid. Finally, simulation examples are carried out on whether to consider transferable loads and orderly charging and discharging of electric vehicles. The comparison shows the impact of the two strategies on the economic benefits of household microgrid, and the validity of the given model is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Rapid Wood Recognition Based on Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix and ELM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Wood recognition based on computer technology relies on a large number of computing services provided by cloud services, which makes it unable to be used in recognition scenarios without a network and cannot run on some low performance devices. These shortcomings limit the application of computer algorithms in wood recognition. The photographs of 13 types of wood that are in circulation in Yunnan Province are taken as the research objects. Based on the gray-level co-occurrence matrix, the wood texture features are extracted, and the extreme learning machine (ELM) is used as the feature classifier, and a method of quickly identifying wood is proposed. Experiments show that compared with traditional machine vision algorithms and deep learning-based wood recognition methods, this method has the characteristics of strong generalization and low energy consumption, and can quickly recognize wood on low-performance hardware. This method can make the recognition model run on some low-performance devices, such as Arduino and Raspberry Pi, which provides a solution for some wood recognition scenarios where the cloud platform cannot be used without a network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a New Serverless Conversational Survey System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Conversational agents or chatbots have great potentials in improving survey responses and accessibility. However, it is still a challenge for researchers without programming skills to create voice-enabled chatbots to conduct customizable surveys. This paper presents a new easy-to-use serverless survey chatbot system based on the existing TigerAware mobile survey platform, called TigerAware chatbot. This chatbot system enables non-technical persons to build and deploy customized surveys on mobile devices as text or voice-based conversations. The system is based on Dialogflow and Firebase Realtime database, supports voice input and social dialog, and provides visual responses for users to select answers among several options. The chatbots can be deployed on any iOS and Android mobile device and platform that support Google Assistant. Survey question types that have been implemented include yes/no, multiple-choice, free response, numeric entry, date/time picker, and scale. This system is more efficient and effective than existing survey chatbot systems.

articleTitle: The Matching Model and Optimization of Private Shared Charging Piles Considering Charging Scheduling under the Reservation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low efficiency in the use of shared charging piles, this study proposes a real-time charging pile reservation system based on shared charging piles, and studies the matching problem of private shared charging piles considering charging scheduling. Firstly, the study establishes a mixed-integer programming model, proves that the optimization problem is an NP-complete problem, and proposes a two-stage heuristic algorithm to quickly generate approximate optimal solutions under real-time conditions. Finally, the study verifies the effectiveness of the proposed matching model and the efficiency of the two-stage algorithm based on randomly generated arithmetic examples. The results of the algorithm case study show that the private shared charging pile matching scheduling scheme considering charging scheduling under the reservation mechanism can effectively reduce the driver search cost and improve the total revenue of private shared charging piles.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Assessment of Ancient Architecture Fire Risk Using Object Element Toposable Gray Clustering Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: On the basis of the traditional fire risk factors, the influence of natural factors was added and the fire risk grading index of ancient buildings was established; the combination of the material element method and gray clustering theory, the classical domain $M_{A0}$, the nodal domain MAP and the risk gray class correlation $\sigma_{ki}$ model were constructed, and finally the correlation vector was established for clustering determination. The results show that the assessment results are close to the actual situation, and the new index system and assessment model can more accurately assess the level of fire risk of Tibetan Buddhist architecture, providing important guidance for early warning and fire management of ancient buildings, while providing a scientific method for the assessment of fire risk of Tibetan Buddhist architecture.

Author Keywords: object element toposable gray clustering model

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Assessment and Measurement Model Applied in the Study of Tourism Information System Perception under Mobile Internet and Smart Terminals
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, based on the rise and popularity of short video, some scenic areas with unique landscapes, rich activities and other characteristics have attracted people’s attention and sought after, becoming veritable online celebrity scenic areas. Faced with the increasingly fierce competition in online celebrity scenic areas, studying the relationship between tourists’ environmental perception and satisfaction is conducive to improving the core competitiveness of online celebrity scenic areas. This paper takes Datang Ever-bright City as a case study, and analyzes the influence mechanism between the environmental perception and satisfaction of tourists in online celebrity scenic area through questionnaire survey and structural equation model analysis method. The results show that tourists’ environmental perception of online celebrity scenic areas includes four dimensions: experience environment, innovative environment, service and management environment, and social environment; the experience environment, innovative environment and social environment of online celebrity scenic areas have a significant direct impact on satisfaction; there is no significant impact between the service and management environment of tourists in online celebrity scenic areas and the satisfaction of tourists.

articleTitle: Intelligent Choreography Algorithm Recorded by Optical Motion Capture System through Directed Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Dance and music are inextricably connected. At present, there are several problems in intelligent music-dance choreography, such as stiff movements, poor beats-alignment between dance and music, and difficulty in long sequences generation. Learning to model music-dance generation is yet challenging. To solve these problems, we propose a new intelligent music-dance choreography framework based on a Directed Graph Nueral Network, through an improved temporal directed graph and spatial directed graph, in which music features and motion features are regarded as control signals, respectively. Utilizing prior knowledge, we added the rotation restrictions of human skeleton to prevent the abnormal joints drift, and feet-end contact restrictions to fix foot slidings. Besides, we constructed a music-dance dataset containing two types recorded by an optical motion capture system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is workable and can generate higher quality dance sequences.

articleTitle: Research on Insulator Defect Detection and Recognition in Overhead Transmission Line Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the overhead transmission line, the insulator plays a very important role in the operation of the power system. Because the insulator is exposed to the field for a long time, the insulator is often damaged, iced and hung with foreign matters. This paper studies the defects of the insulator in the overhead transmission line. In overhead transmission lines, human eyes cannot directly observe the defects of insulators. Insulators in overhead transmission lines are often photographed with the help of unmanned drone, helicopter and other auxiliary equipment, and then identified by different methods. In order to improve the accuracy of insulator defect identification in overhead transmission lines, this paper uses hierarchical detection method to detect and identify insulators. Firstly, fast r-cnn algorithm is used to locate insulators and cut insulators, so as to increase the proportion of insulators in the image. Secondly, image enhancement method is used to expand the data set, finally, yolo-v4 algorithm is used to detect the defects of insulators. In order to improve the speed of insulator detection in overhead transmission lines, resnet50 is used as fast r-cnn feature extraction network in the first level detection; In order to improve the identification accuracy of insulator defects in overhead transmission lines, mobilenetv2 is used as the feature extraction network of yolo-v4 in the second level detection. Experimental results show that this method can effectively and accurately identify and detect insulator defects in overhead transmission lines.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Volatility Forecast Method for Silver by Autoregressive Moving Average and HAR-Type Models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper examines whether investor sentiment, day-of-the-week effect, and structural breaks can enhance the volatility forecasting of the silver futures price. This article develops four types of heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) models, based on the original HAR model. These new models simultaneously combine the structural breaks and day-of-the-week effect altogether to forecast silver futures price, and include the impact of trading volume, crude oil futures’ price volatility, and investor sentiment to improve accuracy. The empirical results reveal that the new models have better in-sample fit than the previous HAR-type models, but these new models have comparatively lower forecasting accuracy. Consistent with prior studies, this paper finds that structural breaks contain incremental prediction information for forecasting the realized volatility of silver prices. Moreover, the day-of-the-week effect contains a significantly negative effect on silver future volatility in the short-term and mid-term periods. The investor sentiment has a significantly positive influence on the price volatility in short-term, mid-term, and long-term periods. More importantly, this paper argues that even though each of these factors has a significant impact on predicting silver futures’ price volatility, combining all of these actually lower the overall forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on the Computer Assisted Design for Flood Resilience in Ho Chi Minh of Vietnam by Big Data and Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Frequent and increasingly severe flooding in Ho Chi Minh City has raised people’s attention on the issue of climate change in recent years. However, the leading cause of today’s environmental risks is not entirely due to climate change but, more importantly, due to the out-of-control urban growth rate. This paper aims to improve the resilience of Ho Chi Minh City to floods and reduce flood damage, and proposes four critical urban design principles: 1) Urban design must consider flooding as an ecological resource; 2) Building flood storage space based on ecological infrastructure to adapt to dynamic changes of floods; 3) Urban spaces need to anticipate many risk scenarios and try to switch to flood adaptive models; 4) Disseminate flood dynamics and raise people’s awareness about living with floods.

articleTitle: Research on communication security of power system based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the concept of “Internet of Things” and the arrival of the 5G era, 5G technology as a new generation of mobile communication technology is widely used in all walks of life. The construction of smart grid and the proposal of the concepts of smart energy” and “smart manufacturing” have promoted the application of 5G technology in power system, especially in power communication system. It is undeniable that the security in the current 5G communication environment is facing risks. Physical layer security is a starting point for proposing ways to improve the security of 5G communication, and RF fingerprint technology is a representative technology of physical layer security. With the rapid development of China’s power industry, the scale of power system will gradually expand, and the future 5G communication technology will also be more widely used in power communication system. The application of 5G-based RF fingerprint technology in power communication system can reliably identify power system communication equipment, which will significantly improve the security of power system communication. This paper mainly studies the radio frequency fingerprint technology of wireless communication and verifies the feasibility of using radio frequency fingerprint technology to identify communication equipment. Firstly, the research status of power system communication security in recent years is summarized. Secondly, 5G secure communication is briefly described, and the idea of using physical layer security to improve communication security is introduced. Finally, the radio frequency fingerprint identification system is summarized, and the role of bispectrum as radio frequency fingerprint in communication equipment identification is verified by simulation of wireless transmitter.

articleTitle: The Computer Assisted Service Design Study of Museum Relying on Internet Multimedia Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Objective The service innovation strategy of Laolongkou Wine Museum was put forward based on service design thinking, to improve the audience experience satisfaction and service level, enhance consumer brand adhesion, and promote the spread and development of traditional brewing techniques and wine culture of intangible cultural heritage Laolongkou wine. Method_Based on the concept of service design and starting from the behavioral needs of museum visitors, this paper analyzes the behavioral characteristics of visitors. User experience map is drawn according to the experience process of visitors, which is conducive to obtaining the service blind spots of Laolongkou Museum and searching for the touchpoints to improve the experience of visitors. Conclusion To optimize the service process and contact points of Laolongkou Wine Museum according to the behavior characteristics of visitors, relying on the immediacy and interactivity of Internet technology, the Laolongkou Wine Museum service system integrating network and entity can be established, which will promote the common development of culture and entertainment and build museums that satisfy visitors.

articleTitle: Selecting Services on Service Computing Based on Context Semantic Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Service selection is a process that aims at identifying a set of services able to satisfy a given set of functional and non-functional requirements. Selecting services is essential for providing services with higher success rate and lower cost. Current Web service selection methods assume that service parameters have the consistent expressions, but neglect the ubiquitous problems of semantic conflicts, causing the decrease of correct rate and the increase of omitting rate. This paper proposes a novel service selection approach based on context semantics. First, we introduce the semantic matching model and the semantic transformation model to solve the semantic conflicts under different contexts. Second, we build a series of pre-defined routines to eliminate the context differences. Finally, we employ service filtering and parameter dimensionless process, so that users can find the service that best matches their requirement. The experimental results show the correct rate and efficiency of service selection increases, and thus the proposed approach is adoptable.
